class AnthropicProvider(wactorz.agents.llm.base.LLMProvider): 
240class AnthropicProvider(LLMProvider):
241    def __init__(self, model: str = "claude-sonnet-4-6", api_key: str | None = None):
242        import anthropic
243
244        self.client = anthropic.AsyncAnthropic(api_key=api_key)
245        self.model = model
246
247    @classmethod
248    def supports_blocks(cls) -> bool:
249        """Block content reaches the API as written — `_request_params` passes
250        `messages` through, so a list content needs no conversion here.
251        """
252        return True
253
254    # ── Request shaping ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
255
256    def _client_carries_temperature(self) -> bool:
257        """Whether this client would carry `temperature`, resolved once.
258
259        Asked of the client in hand rather than the installed SDK: the two are
260        the same object in production and deliberately are not in a test.
261        """
262        cached = getattr(self, "_temp_ok", None)
263        if cached is None:
264            messages = getattr(self.client, "messages", None)
265            cached = all(
266                _carries_temperature(getattr(messages, name, None)) for name in ("create", "stream")
267            )
268            self._temp_ok = cached
269        return cached
270
271    def _request_params(self, messages: list[dict], system: str, kwargs: dict) -> dict[str, Any]:
272        """The common request body, with each optional knob only where it is legal."""
273        params: dict[str, Any] = {
274            "model": self.model,
275            "max_tokens": kwargs.get("max_tokens", 16384),
276            "system": system,
277            "messages": messages,
278        }
279        if self._client_carries_temperature() and not _rejects_temperature(self.model):
280            params.update(_temp_params(kwargs))
281        reasoning_effort = kwargs.get("reasoning_effort")
282        thinking = self._thinking_param(reasoning_effort)
283        if thinking is not None:
284            params["thinking"] = thinking
285        # Effort rides with thinking and only with thinking. Beyond keeping the
286        # two consistent, this is what keeps us off Claude Opus 5's one illegal
287        # combination: it accepts `disabled` at effort `high` or below and 400s
288        # at `xhigh`/`max`, and a request that disables thinking sends no effort
289        # at all, so the default (`high`) applies.
290        if thinking != {"type": "disabled"}:
291            effort = _effort_for(self.model, reasoning_effort)
292            if effort is not None:
293                params["output_config"] = {"effort": effort}
294        return params
295
296    def _thinking_param(self, reasoning_effort: str | None) -> dict[str, str] | None:
297        """The `thinking` block for this request, or None to omit the parameter.
298
299        Every caller in this codebase asks for `reasoning_effort="none"`, which
300        the OpenAI-shaped providers honour. Before Claude Opus 5 that request
301        was satisfied by silence, so this provider never had to send anything;
302        on the models in `_THINKING_ON_BY_DEFAULT` silence now means the
303        opposite, and the request has to say so.
304        """
305        if not _thinks_by_default(self.model):
306            # Thinking is already off unless the caller opts in.
307            return {"type": "adaptive"} if reasoning_effort not in (None, "none") else None
308        if reasoning_effort not in (None, "none"):
309            return {"type": "adaptive"}
310        if not _can_disable_thinking(self.model):
311            logger.warning(
312                "[anthropic] %s cannot disable reasoning; its thinking tokens are "
313                "billed against max_tokens, so a small budget may return no text at all",
314                self.model,
315            )
316            return None
317        return {"type": "disabled"}
318
319    # ── Degrading a request the model refused ───────────────────────────────
320
321    def _degrade(self, exc: Exception, params: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
322        """Whether dropping a parameter this model rejected earns a second try.
323
324        Mutates `params` when it does. One parameter per attempt: a request
325        that would need two of these dropped is a request we have got wrong in
326        a way the caller should see.
327        """
328        return (
329            self._retry_without_temperature(exc, params)
330            or self._retry_without_thinking(exc, params)
331            or self._retry_without_effort(exc, params)
332        )
333
334    def _retry_without_thinking(self, exc: Exception, params: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
335        """Whether dropping `thinking` gives this request a second chance.
336
337        A model released after this file may refuse the parameter outright, or
338        refuse the `adaptive` shape it is too old to know. Losing the whole turn
339        is worse than reasoning we did not ask for, so drop the parameter,
340        remember the model, and let the caller see a real answer.
341        """
342        if "thinking" not in params or not _is_thinking_rejection(exc):
343            return False
344        params.pop("thinking")
345        _learned_no_thinking_param.add(self.model)
346        logger.warning(
347            "[anthropic] %s rejected the `thinking` parameter (%s); retrying without it "
348            "and omitting it for the rest of this process. Reasoning tokens count "
349            "against max_tokens, so tight budgets may return an empty response",
350            self.model,
351            exc,
352        )
353        return True
354
355    def _retry_without_effort(self, exc: Exception, params: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
356        """Whether dropping `output_config` gives this request a second chance.
357
358        Depth is a preference; the answer is not. A model whose accepted levels
359        this file names wrongly costs one 400 and then runs at the API default.
360        """
361        if "output_config" not in params or not _is_effort_rejection(exc):
362            return False
363        params.pop("output_config")
364        _learned_no_effort.add(self.model)
365        logger.warning(
366            "[anthropic] %s does not accept this `output_config.effort` (%s); retrying "
367            "without it and omitting it for the rest of this process",
368            self.model,
369            exc,
370        )
371        return True
372
373    def _retry_without_temperature(self, exc: Exception, params: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
374        """Whether dropping `temperature` gives this request a second chance.
375
376        Mutates `params` when it does, and remembers the model so the rest of
377        the process omits the parameter from the start.
378        """
379        if "temperature" not in params or not _is_temperature_rejection(exc):
380            return False
381        params.pop("temperature")
382        _learned_no_sampling.add(self.model)
383        logger.warning(
384            "[anthropic] %s does not accept `temperature` (%s); retrying without it "
385            "and omitting it for the rest of this process",
386            self.model,
387            exc,
388        )
389        return True
390
391    async def _create(self, params: dict[str, Any]):
392        """`messages.create`, retried once without whatever the model refused."""
393        try:
394            return await self.client.messages.create(**params)  # pyright: ignore[reportCallIssue,reportArgumentType]
395        except Exception as exc:  # re-raised unless it is one of the cases we handle
396            if not self._degrade(exc, params):
397                raise
398        return await self.client.messages.create(**params)  # pyright: ignore[reportCallIssue,reportArgumentType]
399
400    def _extract_text(self, response) -> str:
401        """Join every text block, skipping thinking / redacted_thinking and any
402        other non-text block. Robust whether or not extended thinking is enabled;
403        without this, content[0] is a ThinkingBlock and .text raises.
404
405        A response made entirely of thinking blocks is the failure mode this
406        provider is easiest to hit and hardest to see: nothing raises, and the
407        caller receives "". Callers that coerce a falsy answer to a default —
408        the intent classifier turns it into "OTHER" — then misroute in silence.
409        Say so once, here, where the reason is still visible.
410        """
411        parts: list[str] = []
412        saw_thinking = False
413        for block in getattr(response, "content", None) or []:
414            btype = getattr(block, "type", None)
415            if btype == "text":
416                parts.append(getattr(block, "text", "") or "")
417            elif btype in ("thinking", "redacted_thinking"):
418                saw_thinking = True
419        text = "".join(parts).strip()
420        if not text and saw_thinking:
421            logger.warning(
422                "[anthropic] %s returned only reasoning and no text (stop_reason=%s, "
423                "output_tokens=%s). The token budget was spent thinking; raise max_tokens "
424                "or disable reasoning for this call site",
425                self.model,
426                getattr(response, "stop_reason", None),
427                getattr(getattr(response, "usage", None), "output_tokens", None),
428            )
429        return text
430
431    async def _complete(self, messages: list[dict], system: str = "", **kwargs) -> tuple[str, dict]:
432        response = await self._create(self._request_params(messages, system, kwargs))
433        text = self._extract_text(response)
434        usage = {
435            "input_tokens": response.usage.input_tokens,
436            "output_tokens": response.usage.output_tokens,
437            "cost_usd": calc_cost(
438                self.model, response.usage.input_tokens, response.usage.output_tokens
439            ),
440        }
441        return text, usage
442
443    async def _complete_with_tools(
444        self,
445        messages: list[dict],
446        tools: list[dict[str, Any]],
447        system: str = "",
448        **kwargs: Any,
449    ) -> ToolCompletion:
450        params = self._request_params(self._anthropic_messages(messages), system, kwargs)
451        params["tools"] = self._anthropic_tools(tools)
452        response = await self._create(params)
453        text_parts: list[str] = []
454        tool_calls: list[ToolCall] = []
455        assistant_content: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
456        for block in getattr(response, "content", []) or []:
457            btype = getattr(block, "type", None)
458            if btype == "text":
459                text = getattr(block, "text", "")
460                text_parts.append(text)
461                assistant_content.append({"type": "text", "text": text})
462            elif btype in ("thinking", "redacted_thinking"):
463                # Not shown to anyone, but the next turn of the loop replays
464                # this message and the API requires them back unchanged.
465                replay = _replayable_block(block)
466                if replay is not None:
467                    assistant_content.append(replay)
468            elif btype == "tool_use":
469                name = getattr(block, "name", "")
470                call_id = getattr(block, "id", "")
471                args = getattr(block, "input", {}) or {}
472                if not isinstance(args, dict):
473                    args = {}
474                tool_calls.append(ToolCall(id=call_id, name=name, arguments=args))
475                assistant_content.append(
476                    {"type": "tool_use", "id": call_id, "name": name, "input": args}
477                )
478        usage_obj = getattr(response, "usage", None)
479        input_tok = getattr(usage_obj, "input_tokens", 0) if usage_obj else 0
480        output_tok = getattr(usage_obj, "output_tokens", 0) if usage_obj else 0
481        usage = {
482            "input_tokens": input_tok,
483            "output_tokens": output_tok,
484            "cost_usd": calc_cost(self.model, input_tok, output_tok),
485        }
486        return ToolCompletion(
487            content="".join(text_parts).strip(),
488            usage=usage,
489            tool_calls=tool_calls,
490            assistant_message={"role": "assistant", "content": assistant_content},
491        )
492
493    @staticmethod
494    def _anthropic_tools(tools: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
495        return [
496            {
497                "name": tool["name"],
498                "description": tool.get("description", ""),
499                "input_schema": tool.get("parameters", {"type": "object", "properties": {}}),
500            }
501            for tool in tools
502        ]
503
504    @staticmethod
505    def _anthropic_messages(messages: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
506        converted: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
507        for message in messages:
508            role = message.get("role")
509            if role == "system":
510                continue
511            if role == "tool":
512                converted.append(
513                    {
514                        "role": "user",
515                        "content": [
516                            {
517                                "type": "tool_result",
518                                "tool_use_id": message.get("tool_call_id")
519                                or message.get("id")
520                                or "",
521                                "content": str(message.get("content", "")),
522                                "is_error": bool(message.get("is_error")),
523                            }
524                        ],
525                    }
526                )
527                continue
528            content = message.get("content", "")
529            converted.append(
530                {
531                    "role": "assistant" if role == "assistant" else "user",
532                    "content": content if isinstance(content, list) else str(content),
533                }
534            )
535        return converted
536
537    async def _stream(self, messages: list[dict], system: str = "", **kwargs):
538        """Yield text chunks as they arrive. Final item is a dict with usage."""
539        params = self._request_params(messages, system, kwargs)
540        started = False
541        try:
542            async for item in self._stream_once(params):
543                started = True
544                yield item
545            return
546        except Exception as exc:  # re-raised unless it is one of the cases we handle
547            # The rejection lands on the opening request, before the first
548            # chunk, so retrying cannot replay output the caller already saw.
549            # `started` keeps that true even if a later release moves the error.
550            if started or not self._degrade(exc, params):
551                raise
552        async for item in self._stream_once(params):
553            yield item
554
555    async def _stream_once(self, params: dict[str, Any]):
556        """One streaming attempt, from the request to the closing usage dict."""
557        input_tokens = output_tokens = 0
558        async with self.client.messages.stream(**params) as s:  # pyright: ignore[reportCallIssue,reportArgumentType]
559            async for chunk in s.text_stream:
560                yield chunk
561            # Final message has usage counts
562            final = await s.get_final_message()
563            input_tokens = final.usage.input_tokens
564            output_tokens = final.usage.output_tokens
565        yield {
566            "input_tokens": input_tokens,
567            "output_tokens": output_tokens,
568            "cost_usd": calc_cost(self.model, input_tokens, output_tokens),
569        }

Base class for LLM providers.

Every route to a paid model goes through one of the three public methods here, and each checks the spend limit before delegating to the provider's own _-prefixed implementation. Subclasses implement those and inherit the check, so a new provider — or a new call site — cannot reach the model without it. The limit previously guarded three call sites in this class while the providers were reachable directly, which most callers did.

603        )
604
605        await self.publish_manifest(
606            description=(
607                "Pre-built agent recipe library. "
608                "Spawns ready-made agents by name without requiring code. "
609                f"Available: {', '.join(names)}"
610            ),
611            capabilities=["spawn_catalog_agent", "list_catalog_agents", "agent_catalog"],
612            input_schema={
613                "action": "str — 'spawn' | 'list' | 'info'",
614                "agent": "str — agent name for spawn/info actions",
615            },
616            output_schema={"ok": "bool", "message": "str", "agents": "list", "recipe": "dict"},
617        )
618
619        # Inject recipe manifests directly into main's _agent_manifests dict
620        main: MainActor | None = None
621        for _ in range(20):
622            main = find_main_actor(self._registry)
623            if main:
624                break
625            await asyncio.sleep(0.5)
626
627        for name, recipe in self._catalog.items():
628            manifest = {
629                "name": name,
630                "actor_id": f"catalog.{name}",
631                "description": recipe.get("description", ""),
632                "capabilities": recipe.get("capabilities", []),
633                "input_schema": recipe.get("input_schema", {}),
634                "output_schema": recipe.get("output_schema", {}),
635                "stability": recipe.get("stability", "stable"),
636                "experimental": bool(recipe.get("experimental", False)),
637                "warning": recipe.get("warning", ""),
638                "publishes": [],
639                "spawnable": True,
640                "catalog": self.name,
641                "timestamp": time.time(),
642            }
643
644            if main:
645                main._agent_manifests[name] = manifest
646                logger.info(f"[{self.name}] Injected manifest for '{name}' into main")
647            else:
648                logger.warning(
649                    f"[{self.name}] main not ready — could not inject manifest for '{name}'"
650                )
651
652    def _current_task_description(self) -> str:
653        return f"catalog ({len(self._catalog)} recipes)"
654
655    # ── Message handling ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
656
657    async def handle_message(self, msg: Message):
658        if msg.type != MessageType.TASK:
659            return
660
661        payload = msg.payload if msg.payload is not None else {}
662        result = await self._handle(payload)
663
664        task_id = (
665            payload.get("task") or payload.get("_task_id") if isinstance(payload, dict) else None
666        )
667        if task_id:
668            result["task"] = task_id
669            result["_task_id"] = task_id
670
671        target = msg.reply_to or msg.sender_id
672        if target:
673            await self.send(target, MessageType.RESULT, result)
674
675    async def _handle(self, payload) -> dict:
676        if isinstance(payload, dict) and payload.get("action"):
677            action = payload["action"].lower().strip()
678            if action == "list":
679                filt = str(payload.get("filter", "") or payload.get("agent", ""))
680                return self._action_list(include_experimental=_wants_experimental(filt))
681            if action == "info":
682                return self._action_info(payload.get("agent", ""))
683            if action == "spawn":
684                return await self._action_spawn(payload.get("agent", ""), payload)
685            return {"ok": False, "message": f"Unknown action '{action}'. Use: spawn | list | info"}
686
687        if isinstance(payload, dict) and "spawn" in payload and isinstance(payload["spawn"], str):
688            return await self._action_spawn(payload["spawn"], payload)
689
690        if isinstance(payload, str):
691            text = payload.strip()
692        elif isinstance(payload, dict):
693            text = (
694                payload.get("text") or payload.get("message") or payload.get("query") or ""
695            ).strip()
696        else:
697            text = ""
698
699        if text:
700            parts = text.split(None, 1)
701            cmd = parts[0].lower()
702            arg = parts[1].strip() if len(parts) > 1 else ""
703            if cmd == "list":
704                return self._action_list(include_experimental=_wants_experimental(arg))
705            if cmd == "info":
706                return self._action_info(arg)
707            if cmd == "spawn":
708                return await self._action_spawn(arg, {})
709            if self._resolve_name(cmd):
710                return await self._action_spawn(cmd, {})
711
712        return self._action_list()
713
714    # ── Name resolution ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
715
716    def _resolve_name(self, raw: str) -> str | None:
717        """Map a freeform name to a catalog key.
718
719        Tries in order:
720          1. Exact match
721          2. Normalised match (spaces/underscores → dashes, lowercase)
722          3. Strip a trailing ' agent' / '-agent' suffix and retry
723          4. Word-subset match: any catalog key whose slug-words are all present
724             in the input (ignoring the word 'agent')
725        """
726        if not raw:
727            return None
728
729        # 1. Exact
730        if raw in self._catalog:
731            return raw
732
733        # 2. Normalised
734        norm = raw.lower().strip().replace("_", "-").replace(" ", "-")
735        if norm in self._catalog:
736            return norm
737
738        # 3. Strip trailing '-agent' suffix
739        stripped = norm.removesuffix("-agent")
740        if stripped and stripped in self._catalog:
741            return stripped
742
743        # 4. Word-subset: split input into meaningful words (drop 'agent'),
744        #    then find the first catalog key whose words are all present.
745        stop = {"agent", "the", "a", "an"}
746        input_words = {w for w in norm.replace("-", " ").split() if w not in stop}
747        if input_words:
748            for key in self._catalog:
749                key_words = set(key.replace("-", " ").split()) - stop
750                if key_words and key_words.issubset(input_words):
751                    return key
752
753        return None
754
755    # ── Actions ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
756
757    def _action_list(self, include_experimental: bool = False) -> dict:
758        """List catalog agents. The full set (including beta) is always returned
759        in ``agents`` so other consumers get complete data; ``show_experimental``
760        tells the chat formatter whether to display the beta agents or hide them
761        behind a hint. Beta agents are hidden by default — the caller opts in with
762        a request like "list experimental".
763        """
764        agents = []
765        for name, recipe in self._catalog.items():
766            agents.append(
767                {
768                    "name": name,
769                    "description": recipe.get("description", ""),
770                    "capabilities": recipe.get("capabilities", []),
771                    "stability": recipe.get("stability", "stable"),
772                    "experimental": bool(recipe.get("experimental", False)),
773                    "warning": recipe.get("warning", ""),
774                }
775            )
776        return {
777            "ok": True,
778            "message": f"{len(agents)} agent(s) available in catalog",
779            "agents": agents,
780            "show_experimental": include_experimental,
781        }
782
783    def _action_info(self, name: str) -> dict:
784        if not name:
785            return {"ok": False, "message": "Provide 'agent' name for info action"}
786        resolved = self._resolve_name(name)
787        recipe = self._catalog.get(resolved) if resolved else None
788        if not recipe:
789            available = list(self._catalog.keys())
790            return {"ok": False, "message": f"'{name}' not in catalog. Available: {available}"}
791        safe = {k: v for k, v in recipe.items() if k not in {"code", "factory"}}
792        message = f"Recipe for '{resolved}'"
793        if recipe.get("experimental"):
794            message += (
795                f" ({recipe.get('stability', 'beta')}: {recipe.get('warning', BETA_WARNING)})"
796            )
797        return {"ok": True, "message": message, "recipe": safe}
798
799    async def _action_spawn(self, name: str, payload: dict) -> dict:
800        if not name:
801            return {"ok": False, "message": "Provide 'agent' name to spawn"}
802
803        resolved = self._resolve_name(name)
804        recipe = self._catalog.get(resolved) if resolved else None
805        if not resolved or not recipe:
806            available = list(self._catalog.keys())
807            return {"ok": False, "message": f"'{name}' not in catalog. Available: {available}"}
808
809        if not self._registry:
810            return {"ok": False, "message": "No registry available — cannot spawn"}
811
812        existing = self._registry.find_by_name(resolved)
813        if existing:
814            return {"ok": True, "message": f"'{resolved}' is already running"}
815
816        beta_warning = recipe.get("warning") if recipe.get("experimental") else ""
817        if beta_warning:
818            await self._mqtt_publish(
819                f"agents/{self.actor_id}/alert",
820                {
821                    "severity": "warning",
822                    "message": f"{resolved} is Experimental/Beta. {beta_warning}",
823                    "timestamp": time.time(),
824                },
825            )
826
827        logger.info(f"[{self.name}] Spawning '{resolved}'...")
828        await self._mqtt_publish(
829            f"agents/{self.actor_id}/logs",
830            {"type": "log", "message": f"Spawning '{resolved}'...", "timestamp": time.time()},
831        )
832
833        try:
834            main = find_main_actor(self._registry)
835            llm_provider = main.llm if main else None
836            persistence_dir = str(main._persistence_dir.parent) if main else resolve_state_dir()
837
838            if recipe.get("type") == "native":
839                factory = recipe.get("factory")
840                if not factory:
841                    return {"ok": False, "message": f"Native recipe '{resolved}' has no factory"}
842                native_kwargs: dict[str, Any] = {
843                    "name": resolved,
844                    "persistence_dir": persistence_dir,
845                }
846                if llm_provider:
847                    native_kwargs["llm_provider"] = llm_provider
848                actor = await self.spawn(factory, **native_kwargs)
849                if actor:
850                    if main:
851                        # Persist a JSON-safe descriptor so the agent is restored
852                        # after a process restart. The factory (a class object)
853                        # is dropped — it is re-resolved by name via
854                        # get_native_factory() on restore. Mark trusted so it
855                        # bypasses the safety validator like other catalog agents.
856                        save_config = {k: v for k, v in recipe.items() if k != "factory"}
857                        save_config["trusted"] = True
858                        main._save_to_spawn_registry(save_config)
859                    msg = _chat_message_with_beta_warning(
860                        f"'{resolved}' spawned and running", beta_warning
861                    )
862                    logger.info(f"[{self.name}] {msg}")
863                    await self._mqtt_publish(
864                        f"agents/{self.actor_id}/logs",
865                        {"type": "log", "message": msg, "timestamp": time.time()},
866                    )
867                    return {"ok": True, "message": msg, "agent": resolved}
868                return {"ok": False, "message": f"Spawn returned no actor for '{resolved}'"}
869
870            from .dynamic import DynamicAgent
871
872            install = recipe.get("install", [])
873            if install:
874                # Fast-path: check which packages are already importable.
875                # Avoids a 120s installer wait when deps were installed in a
876                # previous session — same logic as main._spawn_dynamic_agent.
877                needed = [pkg for pkg in install if not _dependency_is_satisfied(pkg)]
878
879                if needed:
880                    installer = self._registry.find_by_name("installer") if self._registry else None
881                    if installer:
882                        logger.info(f"[{self.name}] Installing missing deps for '{name}': {needed}")
883                        import uuid as _uuid
884
885                        task_id = f"cat_install_{_uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
886                        future = asyncio.get_running_loop().create_future()
887                        main = find_main_actor(self._registry)
888                        if main:
889                            main._result_futures[task_id] = future
890                        # Send with reply_to=main.actor_id so the installer's RESULT goes
891                        # directly to main where the future is registered.
892                        install_msg = Message(
893                            type=MessageType.TASK,
894                            sender_id=self.actor_id,
895                            reply_to=main.actor_id if main else self.actor_id,
896                            payload={
897                                "action": "install",
898                                "packages": needed,
899                                "task": task_id,
900                                "_task_id": task_id,
901                            },
902                        )
903                        await installer.receive(install_msg)
904                        try:
905                            await asyncio.wait_for(future, timeout=120.0)
906                        except asyncio.TimeoutError:
907                            logger.warning(
908                                f"[{self.name}] Install timeout for '{name}' — proceeding anyway"
909                            )
910                    else:
911                        logger.warning(
912                            f"[{self.name}] installer not found — skipping dep install for '{name}'"
913                        )
914                else:
915                    logger.info(
916                        f"[{self.name}] All deps for '{resolved}' already installed — skipping installer"
917                    )
918
919            actor = await self.spawn(
920                DynamicAgent,
921                name=resolved,
922                code=recipe["code"],
923                poll_interval=float(recipe.get("poll_interval", 3600)),
924                description=recipe.get("description", ""),
925                input_schema=recipe.get("input_schema", {}),
926                output_schema=recipe.get("output_schema", {}),
927                llm_provider=llm_provider,
928                persistence_dir=persistence_dir,
929                trusted=True,  # catalog agents are pre-built — skip safety validator
930            )
931
932            if actor:
933                if main:
934                    # Mark as trusted so it bypasses safety validator on restore
935                    save_config = dict(recipe)
936                    save_config["trusted"] = True
937                    main._save_to_spawn_registry(save_config)
938
939                msg = _chat_message_with_beta_warning(
940                    f"'{resolved}' spawned and running", beta_warning
941                )
942                logger.info(f"[{self.name}] {msg}")
943                await self._mqtt_publish(
944                    f"agents/{self.actor_id}/logs",
945                    {"type": "log", "message": msg, "timestamp": time.time()},
946                )
947                return {"ok": True, "message": msg, "agent": resolved}
948            return {"ok": False, "message": f"Spawn returned no actor for '{resolved}'"}
949
950        except Exception as e:
951            msg = f"Failed to spawn '{resolved}': {e}"
952            logger.error(f"[{self.name}] {msg}")
953            return {"ok": False, "message": msg}
954
955    # Public API ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
956
957    def list_recipes(self) -> list[str]:
958        return list(self._catalog.keys())
959
960    def get_recipe(self, name: str) -> dict | None:
961        return self._catalog.get(name)
