class HomeAssistantAgent(wactorz.LLMAgent): 
  85class HomeAssistantAgent(LLMAgent):
  86    """Unified Home Assistant agent: hardware recommendations, automation CRUD, and entity history."""
  87
  88    DESCRIPTION = (
  89        "Controls Home Assistant: automations, devices, areas, entities, and entity history. "
  90        "Supports natural language queries (current state, camera snapshots, historical data) "
  91        "and structured agent-to-agent operations via the 'operation' payload field."
  92    )
  93    CAPABILITIES: ClassVar[list[str]] = [
  94        "home_automation",
  95        "ha_automations",
  96        "ha_devices",
  97        "ha_entities",
  98        "ha_history",
  99    ]
 100    INPUT_SCHEMA: ClassVar[dict[str, Any]] = {
 101        "text": "str — natural language command or query, e.g. 'turn on living room lights', "
 102        "'list all automations', 'what was the office temperature yesterday at 17:00?'",
 103        "operation": (
 104            "str (optional) — structured agent-to-agent operation, bypasses LLM. "
 105            "Supported values: "
 106            "'list_cameras' — list all camera entities; "
 107            "'get_camera_snapshot' (+ camera_entity_id: str) — capture JPEG snapshot; "
 108            "'get_camera_stream_url' (+ camera_entity_id: str) — get all stream URLs; "
 109            "'get_camera_snapshot_url' (+ camera_entity_id: str) — get snapshot URL; "
 110            "'get_history' (+ entity_ids: list[str], start_time?: str, end_time?: str) — "
 111            "fetch entity state history; times are ISO-8601, agent stores/returns UTC."
 112        ),
 113    }
 114    OUTPUT_SCHEMA: ClassVar[dict[str, Any]] = {
 115        "result": "str — human-readable confirmation or summary",
 116        "data": "list|dict|null — structured HA API response when applicable",
 117        "csv": "str — CSV of entity history rows (only present for get_history operation)",
 118        "format": "str — 'csv' when csv field is present",
 119    }
 120
 121    def __init__(self, llm_provider: LLMProvider | None = None, **kwargs) -> None:
 122        kwargs.setdefault("name", "home-assistant-agent")
 123        kwargs.setdefault("system_prompt", AUTOMATION_CREATION_PROMPT)
 124        super().__init__(llm_provider=llm_provider, **kwargs)
 125        self.ha_url = (CONFIG.ha_url).rstrip("/")
 126        self.ha_token = (CONFIG.ha_token).strip()
 127        self._device_cache: dict[str, Any] = {"timestamp": 0.0, "data": None}
 128        self._device_cache_ttl = 30.0
 129        self._automation_cache: dict[str, Any] = {"timestamp": 0.0, "data": None}
 130        self._automation_cache_ttl = 30.0
 131        self._other_tool_max_rounds = 3
 132
 133    # ── Cost tracking helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
 134
 135    def _accumulate_usage(self, usage: dict) -> None:
 136        """Add token counts and cost from one llm.complete() call to running totals."""
 137        if not isinstance(usage, dict):
 138            return
 139        self.total_input_tokens += usage.get("input_tokens", 0)
 140        self.total_output_tokens += usage.get("output_tokens", 0)
 141        self.total_cost_usd += usage.get("cost_usd", 0.0)
 142        self._persist_cost()
 143
 144    # ── Public entry points ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
 145
 146    async def chat(self, user_message: str) -> str:
 147        """Direct entry point used by CLI when addressing this agent."""
 148        ts_user = time.time()
 149        self._conversation_history.append({"role": "user", "content": user_message, "ts": ts_user})
 150        result = await self._process(user_message)
 151        response = str(result.get("result", ""))
 152        ts_reply = time.time()
 153        self._conversation_history.append(
 154            {"role": "assistant", "content": response, "ts": ts_reply}
 155        )
 156        await self._maybe_summarize()
 157        self.persist("conversation_history", self._conversation_history)
 158        self._log_chat_turn(user_message, response, ts_user=ts_user, ts_reply=ts_reply)
 159        return response
 160
 161    async def chat_stream(self, user_message: str):
 162        """Override LLMAgent streaming path so direct @home-assistant-agent calls
 163        still use Home Assistant intent routing instead of generic LLM chat.
 164        """
 165        response = await self.chat(user_message)
 166        yield response
 167        yield {}
 168
 169    async def handle_message(self, msg: Message) -> None:
 170        if msg.type != MessageType.TASK:
 171            return
 172
 173        text, entities, hardware = self._extract_payload(msg.payload)
 174
 175        operation = msg.payload.get("operation") if isinstance(msg.payload, dict) else None
 176        camera_entity_id = (
 177            str(msg.payload.get("camera_entity_id", "")).strip()
 178            if isinstance(msg.payload, dict)
 179            else ""
 180        )
 181
 182        if operation:
 183            logger.debug(
 184                f"[{self.name}] operation={operation} camera_entity_id={camera_entity_id!r} from={msg.sender_id}"
 185            )
 186
 187        if operation == "list_cameras":
 188            result = await self._list_cameras()
 189        elif operation == "get_camera_snapshot":
 190            result = await self._camera_snapshot(camera_entity_id)
 191        elif operation == "get_camera_stream_url":
 192            result = await self._camera_stream_url(camera_entity_id)
 193        elif operation == "get_camera_snapshot_url":
 194            result = await self._camera_snapshot_url(camera_entity_id)
 195        elif operation == "get_history":
 196            result = await self._get_history(msg.payload if isinstance(msg.payload, dict) else {})
 197        elif entities or hardware:
 198            # Pre-selected entities/hardware provided (e.g. direct API call) — skip
 199            # classification and go straight to automation creation.
 200            result = await self._create_automation(text, entities, hardware)
 201        else:
 202            result = await self._process(text)
 203
 204        if isinstance(result, dict):
 205            result.setdefault("task", self._extract_task_id(msg.payload, text))
 206            # Echo _task_id so planner futures resolve correctly
 207            if isinstance(msg.payload, dict) and msg.payload.get("_task_id"):
 208                result["_task_id"] = msg.payload["_task_id"]
 209
 210        self.metrics.tasks_completed += 1
 211        if msg.sender_id:
 212            await self.send(msg.sender_id, MessageType.RESULT, result)
 213
 214    # ── Dispatch ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 215
 216    async def _process(self, text: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
 217        """Classify intent then route to the appropriate handler."""
 218        action = await self._classify_action(text)
 219        logger.info("[%s] Classified action: %s", self.name, action)
 220
 221        if action == "list_areas":
 222            return await self._list_areas()
 223
 224        if action == "list_devices":
 225            return await self._list_devices()
 226
 227        if action == "list_entities":
 228            return await self._list_entities()
 229
 230        if action == "get_entities_state":
 231            return await self._handle_entities_state_request(text)
 232
 233        if action == "list_automations":
 234            automations = await self._get_automations_brief()
 235            return self._list_automations(automations)
 236
 237        if action == "delete_automation":
 238            automations = await self._get_automations_brief()
 239            return await self._delete_automation(text, automations)
 240
 241        if action == "edit_automation":
 242            automations = await self._get_automations_brief()
 243            devices = await self._get_devices()
 244            logger.info("[%s] Got devices from Home Assistant", self.name)
 245            return await self._edit_automation(text, automations, devices)
 246
 247        if action == "recommend_hardware":
 248            devices = await self._get_devices()
 249            logger.info("[%s] Got devices from Home Assistant", self.name)
 250            return await self._recommend_hardware(text, devices)
 251
 252        if action == "create_automation":
 253            # Deliberately not a create. Wactorz runs reactive rules itself rather
 254            # than writing Home Assistant automations, so a request to build one is
 255            # routed to PIPELINE upstream and never normally arrives here. What is
 256            # left is the answer for one that slips through anyway: report the
 257            # hardware that could serve the rule, rather than claim a create.
 258            devices = await self._get_devices()
 259            logger.info(
 260                "[%s] Automation creation is a pipeline, not a HA automation; "
 261                "answering with hardware for: %s",
 262                self.name,
 263                text[:80],
 264            )
 265            recommendation = await self._recommend_hardware(text, devices)
 266            details = str(recommendation.get("result") or "").strip()
 267            notice = (
 268                "I did not create the automation because automation creation is currently disabled."
 269            )
 270            recommendation["created"] = False
 271            recommendation["result"] = f"{notice}\n{details}".strip()
 272            return recommendation
 273
 274        if action == "other":
 275            return await self._handle_other_request(text)
 276
 277        return self._unsupported_action_response(text)
 278
 279    # ── Intent classification ────────────────────────────────────────────────
 280
 281    async def _classify_action(self, text: str) -> str:
 282        """Return one action string via a cheap single-word LLM call."""
 283        valid = {
 284            "recommend_hardware",
 285            "create_automation",
 286            "delete_automation",
 287            "edit_automation",
 288            "list_automations",
 289            "list_areas",
 290            "list_devices",
 291            "list_entities",
 292            "other",
 293            "unknown",
 294        }
 295
 296        heuristic = self._classify_action_heuristic(text)
 297        if heuristic == "get_entities_state":
 298            return heuristic
 299
 300        if self.llm is None:
 301            logger.warning(
 302                "[%s] No LLM provider configured; skipping action classification LLM call.",
 303                self.name,
 304            )
 305            return heuristic
 306
 307        try:
 308            response, usage = await self.llm.complete(
 309                messages=[{"role": "user", "content": text}],
 310                system=HA_ACTION_CLASSIFICATION_PROMPT,
 311                max_completion_tokens=20,
 312            )
 313            self._accumulate_usage(usage)
 314            word = (response or "").strip().lower().split()[0] if (response or "").strip() else ""
 315            if word in valid:
 316                return word
 317        except Exception as exc:
 318            logger.warning("[%s] Action classification LLM call failed: %s", self.name, exc)
 319
 320        return heuristic
 321
 322    @staticmethod
 323    def _classify_action_heuristic(text: str) -> str:
 324        lower = text.lower()
 325        if any(w in lower for w in ("list areas", "show areas", "show me areas", "what areas")):
 326            return "list_areas"
 327        if any(
 328            w in lower for w in ("list devices", "show devices", "show me devices", "what devices")
 329        ):
 330            return "list_devices"
 331        if any(
 332            w in lower
 333            for w in ("list entities", "show entities", "show me entities", "what entities")
 334        ):
 335            return "list_entities"
 336        if "get_entities_state" in lower:
 337            return "get_entities_state"
 338        if any(
 339            w in lower
 340            for w in (
 341                "list automations",
 342                "show automations",
 343                "show all automations",
 344                "what automations",
 345                "what are my automations",
 346            )
 347        ):
 348            return "list_automations"
 349        if any(
 350            w in lower for w in ("delete automation", "remove automation", "disable automation")
 351        ):
 352            return "delete_automation"
 353        if any(
 354            w in lower
 355            for w in (
 356                "edit automation",
 357                "update automation",
 358                "change automation",
 359                "modify automation",
 360                "rename automation",
 361            )
 362        ):
 363            return "edit_automation"
 364        if "automation" in lower and any(
 365            w in lower for w in ("create", "add", "new", "build", "make", "set up")
 366        ):
 367            return "create_automation"
 368        if any(
 369            w in lower
 370            for w in ("hardware", "what device", "what sensor", "what do i need", "compatible with")
 371        ):
 372            return "recommend_hardware"
 373        if any(
 374            w in lower
 375            for w in (
 376                "create",
 377                "add automation",
 378                "new automation",
 379                "build automation",
 380                "make automation",
 381            )
 382        ):
 383            return "create_automation"
 384        ha_context_terms = (
 385            "home assistant",
 386            "hass",
 387            "entity",
 388            "entities",
 389            "device",
 390            "devices",
 391            "sensor",
 392            "sensors",
 393            "light",
 394            "lights",
 395            "switch",
 396            "thermostat",
 397            "thermometer",
 398            "thermometers",
 399            "temperature",
 400            "humidity",
 401            "garage",
 402            "kitchen",
 403            "bedroom",
 404            "living room",
 405            "hallway",
 406            "bathroom",
 407            "room",
 408            "rooms",
 409            "camera",
 410            "cameras",
 411            "snapshot",
 412            "stream",
 413        )
 414        if re.search(r"\bha\b", lower) or any(term in lower for term in ha_context_terms):
 415            return "other"
 416        return "unknown"
 417
 418    @staticmethod
 419    def _unsupported_action_response(text: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
 420        return {
 421            "task": text,
 422            "result": (
 423                "I can help with Home Assistant hardware recommendations and automations: "
 424                "create, edit, delete, list automations, list areas, list devices, and list entities."
 425            ),
 426        }
 427
 428    async def _handle_entities_state_request(self, text: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
 429        entity_ids = self._extract_entity_ids(text)
 430        if not entity_ids:
 431            return {
 432                "task": text,
 433                "result": "Please include one or more explicit Home Assistant entity IDs, like sensor.kitchen_temperature.",
 434                "error": "explicit_entity_id_required",
 435            }
 436        if not self.ha_url or not self.ha_token:
 437            return {
 438                "task": text,
 439                "result": "HA_URL or HA_TOKEN not configured.",
 440                "error": "HA_URL or HA_TOKEN not configured.",
 441            }
 442
 443        try:
 444            states = await get_states(self.ha_url, self.ha_token)
 445        except Exception as exc:
 446            return {
 447                "task": text,
 448                "result": f"Home Assistant state query failed: {exc}",
 449                "error": str(exc),
 450            }
 451
 452        states_by_id = {s.get("entity_id"): s for s in states or [] if isinstance(s, dict)}
 453        found = {eid: states_by_id[eid] for eid in entity_ids if eid in states_by_id}
 454        missing = [eid for eid in entity_ids if eid not in found]
 455
 456        for entity_id, state_obj in found.items():
 457            # Publish using the original topic format (entity_id as topic) so
 458            # existing tests and subscribers are not broken, but include the
 459            # full state object and entity_id in the payload so that dynamic
 460            # agents filtering on payload.get('entity_id') work correctly.
 461            # homeassistant/state_changes/# wildcards match this topic since
 462            # entity_id is a subtopic path (e.g. sensor.living_room_temp).
 463            await self._mqtt_publish(
 464                f"homeassistant/state_changes/{entity_id}",
 465                {
 466                    "event_type": "state_changed",
 467                    "entity_id": entity_id,
 468                    "new_state": state_obj,
 469                    "old_state": None,
 470                },
 471            )
 472
 473        parts = [
 474            f"{entity_id}: {state.get('state', 'unknown')}" for entity_id, state in found.items()
 475        ]
 476        if missing:
 477            parts.append("Missing: " + ", ".join(missing))
 478
 479        return {
 480            "task": text,
 481            "result": "; ".join(parts) if parts else "No requested entity states were found.",
 482            "data": {"states": found, "missing": missing},
 483        }
 484
 485    # ── Camera direct handlers (A2A) ─────────────────────────────────────────
 486
 487    async def _list_cameras(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
 488        if not self.ha_url or not self.ha_token:
 489            return {"result": "HA_URL or HA_TOKEN not configured.", "cameras": []}
 490        try:
 491            cameras = await get_camera_entities(self.ha_url, self.ha_token)
 492            if not cameras:
 493                return {"result": "No camera entities found in Home Assistant.", "cameras": []}
 494            lines = [f"Found {len(cameras)} camera(s):"]
 495            for c in cameras:
 496                name = c.get("friendly_name") or c["entity_id"]
 497                lines.append(f"- {name} ({c['entity_id']}) — {c.get('state', 'unknown')}")
 498            return {"result": "\n".join(lines), "cameras": cameras}
 499        except Exception as exc:
 500            return {"result": f"Camera list failed: {exc}", "error": str(exc), "cameras": []}
 501
 502    async def _camera_snapshot(self, camera_entity_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
 503        if not self.ha_url or not self.ha_token:
 504            return {"result": "HA_URL or HA_TOKEN not configured.", "error": "not_configured"}
 505        if not camera_entity_id:
 506            return {"result": "camera_entity_id is required.", "error": "missing_entity_id"}
 507        rest_base = normalize_ha_base_url(self.ha_url)
 508        snapshot = await get_camera_snapshot(rest_base, self.ha_token, camera_entity_id)
 509        if "error" in snapshot:
 510            logger.warning(
 511                f"[{self.name}] get_camera_snapshot({camera_entity_id}) failed: {snapshot['error']}"
 512            )
 513            return {"result": f"Snapshot failed: {snapshot['error']}", "error": snapshot["error"]}
 514        logger.debug(
 515            f"[{self.name}] get_camera_snapshot({camera_entity_id}) -> {len(snapshot.get('image_base64', ''))} b64 chars"
 516        )
 517        return {
 518            "result": f"Snapshot captured for {camera_entity_id}.",
 519            "data": snapshot,
 520        }
 521
 522    async def _camera_stream_url(self, camera_entity_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
 523        if not self.ha_url or not self.ha_token:
 524            return {"result": "HA_URL or HA_TOKEN not configured.", "error": "not_configured"}
 525        if not camera_entity_id:
 526            return {"result": "camera_entity_id is required.", "error": "missing_entity_id"}
 527        data = await get_camera_stream_urls(self.ha_url, self.ha_token, camera_entity_id)
 528        streams = data.get("streams", {})
 529        logger.debug(f"[{self.name}] get_camera_stream_url({camera_entity_id}) -> {streams}")
 530        lines = [f"Stream URLs for {camera_entity_id}:"]
 531        for kind, url in streams.items():
 532            lines.append(f"  {kind}: {url}")
 533        return {"result": "\n".join(lines), "data": data}
 534
 535    async def _camera_snapshot_url(self, camera_entity_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
 536        if not self.ha_url or not self.ha_token:
 537            return {"result": "HA_URL or HA_TOKEN not configured.", "error": "not_configured"}
 538        if not camera_entity_id:
 539            return {"result": "camera_entity_id is required.", "error": "missing_entity_id"}
 540        rest_base = normalize_ha_base_url(self.ha_url)
 541        url = get_camera_snapshot_url(rest_base, camera_entity_id)
 542        logger.debug(f"[{self.name}] get_camera_snapshot_url({camera_entity_id}) -> {url}")
 543        return {
 544            "result": (
 545                f"Snapshot URL for {camera_entity_id}: {url}\n"
 546                "Requires header Authorization: Bearer <HA_TOKEN> to fetch."
 547            ),
 548            "data": {"entity_id": camera_entity_id, "snapshot_url": url},
 549        }
 550
 551    async def _get_history(self, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
 552        """Deterministic agent-to-agent path: fetch entity history and return it as CSV.
 553
 554        No LLM is involved — used when another agent sends a structured
 555        ``operation: "get_history"`` task instead of a natural-language request.
 556        """
 557        if not self.ha_url or not self.ha_token:
 558            return {"result": "HA_URL or HA_TOKEN not configured.", "error": "not_configured"}
 559
 560        entity_ids = payload.get("entity_ids") or payload.get("entity_id") or []
 561        if isinstance(entity_ids, str):
 562            entity_ids = [entity_ids]
 563        if not entity_ids:
 564            return {"result": "entity_ids is required.", "error": "missing_entity_ids"}
 565
 566        start_time = payload.get("start_time") or payload.get("start")
 567        end_time = payload.get("end_time") or payload.get("end")
 568
 569        try:
 570            history = await get_entity_history(
 571                self.ha_url,
 572                self.ha_token,
 573                entity_ids,
 574                start_time=start_time,
 575                end_time=end_time,
 576            )
 577        except Exception as exc:
 578            return {"result": f"Entity history fetch failed: {exc}", "error": str(exc)}
 579
 580        if "error" in history:
 581            return {
 582                "result": f"Entity history fetch failed: {history['error']}",
 583                "error": history["error"],
 584            }
 585
 586        csv_str = history_to_csv(history)
 587        return {
 588            "result": f"Fetched history for {len(entity_ids)} entit{'y' if len(entity_ids) == 1 else 'ies'}.",
 589            "data": history,
 590            "csv": csv_str,
 591            "format": "csv",
 592        }
 593
 594    async def _handle_other_request(self, text: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
 595        if not self.ha_url or not self.ha_token:
 596            return {
 597                "task": text,
 598                "result": "HA_URL or HA_TOKEN not configured.",
 599                "error": "HA_URL or HA_TOKEN not configured.",
 600            }
 601        if self.llm is None:
 602            return {
 603                "task": text,
 604                "result": "No LLM provider configured.",
 605                "error": "No LLM provider configured.",
 606            }
 607
 608        now_iso = datetime.now().astimezone().strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z")
 609        user_content = f"[Current datetime: {now_iso}]\n{text}"
 610        messages: list[dict[str, Any]] = [{"role": "user", "content": user_content}]
 611        tool_cache: dict[str, str] = {}
 612        snapshots_taken: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
 613        tools = [
 614            HA_OTHER_TOOL,
 615            HA_CAMERA_LIST_TOOL,
 616            HA_CAMERA_SNAPSHOT_TOOL,
 617            HA_CAMERA_STREAM_TOOL,
 618            HA_HISTORY_TOOL,
 619        ]
 620
 621        for _round in range(self._other_tool_max_rounds):
 622            try:
 623                completion = await self.llm.complete_with_tools(
 624                    messages=messages,
 625                    tools=tools,
 626                    system=HA_OTHER_PROMPT,
 627                    max_tokens=1200,
 628                )
 629            except Exception as exc:
 630                logger.warning("[%s] Other HA tool loop failed: %s", self.name, exc)
 631                return {
 632                    "task": text,
 633                    "result": f"Home Assistant tool request failed: {exc}",
 634                    "error": str(exc),
 635                }
 636
 637            self._accumulate_usage(getattr(completion, "usage", {}))
 638            tool_calls = list(getattr(completion, "tool_calls", []) or [])
 639            if not tool_calls:
 640                content = str(getattr(completion, "content", "") or "").strip()
 641                result_text = content or "I could not answer that Home Assistant request."
 642                for snap in snapshots_taken:
 643                    b64 = snap.get("image_base64", "")
 644                    ct = snap.get("content_type", "image/jpeg")
 645                    eid = snap.get("entity_id", "snapshot")
 646                    if b64:
 647                        result_text += f"\n\n![{eid}](data:{ct};base64,{b64})"
 648                return {"task": text, "result": result_text}
 649
 650            assistant_message = getattr(completion, "assistant_message", None)
 651            if assistant_message:
 652                messages.append(assistant_message)
 653
 654            for call in tool_calls:
 655                tool_name = getattr(call, "name", "")
 656                tool_call_id = getattr(call, "id", "") or tool_name
 657                is_error = False
 658                if tool_name == "get_simplified_ha_data":
 659                    if tool_name not in tool_cache:
 660                        try:
 661                            data = await get_simplified_ha_data(self.ha_url, self.ha_token)
 662                            tool_cache[tool_name] = json.dumps(data, default=str)
 663                        except Exception as exc:
 664                            tool_cache[tool_name] = f"Home Assistant data fetch failed: {exc}"
 665                            is_error = True
 666                    result_text = tool_cache[tool_name]
 667                elif tool_name == "list_camera_entities":
 668                    if tool_name not in tool_cache:
 669                        try:
 670                            cameras = await get_camera_entities(self.ha_url, self.ha_token)
 671                            tool_cache[tool_name] = json.dumps(cameras, default=str)
 672                        except Exception as exc:
 673                            tool_cache[tool_name] = f"Camera list failed: {exc}"
 674                            is_error = True
 675                    result_text = tool_cache[tool_name]
 676                elif tool_name == "get_camera_snapshot":
 677                    args = getattr(call, "arguments", {}) or {}
 678                    entity_id = str(args.get("camera_entity_id", "")).strip()
 679                    try:
 680                        rest_base = normalize_ha_base_url(self.ha_url)
 681                        snapshot = await get_camera_snapshot(rest_base, self.ha_token, entity_id)
 682                        if "error" in snapshot:
 683                            is_error = True
 684                            result_text = json.dumps(
 685                                {k: v for k, v in snapshot.items() if k != "image_base64"},
 686                                default=str,
 687                            )
 688                        else:
 689                            snapshots_taken.append(snapshot)
 690                            result_text = json.dumps(
 691                                {
 692                                    "entity_id": entity_id,
 693                                    "content_type": snapshot.get("content_type"),
 694                                },
 695                                default=str,
 696                            )
 697                    except Exception as exc:
 698                        result_text = f"Snapshot failed: {exc}"
 699                        is_error = True
 700                elif tool_name == "get_camera_stream_url":
 701                    args = getattr(call, "arguments", {}) or {}
 702                    entity_id = str(args.get("camera_entity_id", "")).strip()
 703                    try:
 704                        stream_data = await get_camera_stream_urls(
 705                            self.ha_url, self.ha_token, entity_id
 706                        )
 707                        result_text = json.dumps(stream_data, default=str)
 708                    except Exception as exc:
 709                        result_text = f"Stream URL fetch failed: {exc}"
 710                        is_error = True
 711                elif tool_name == "get_entity_history":
 712                    args = getattr(call, "arguments", {}) or {}
 713                    eids = args.get("entity_ids") or []
 714                    start = to_utc(args["start_time"]) if args.get("start_time") else None
 715                    end = to_utc(args["end_time"]) if args.get("end_time") else None
 716                    try:
 717                        history = await get_entity_history(
 718                            self.ha_url,
 719                            self.ha_token,
 720                            eids,
 721                            start_time=start,
 722                            end_time=end,
 723                        )
 724                        if "error" in history:
 725                            is_error = True
 726                        else:
 727                            history = localise_history_timestamps(history)
 728                        result_text = json.dumps(history, default=str)
 729                    except Exception as exc:
 730                        result_text = f"Entity history fetch failed: {exc}"
 731                        is_error = True
 732                else:
 733                    result_text = f"Unsupported tool: {tool_name}"
 734                    is_error = True
 735                messages.append(
 736                    {
 737                        "role": "tool",
 738                        "tool_call_id": tool_call_id,
 739                        "name": tool_name,
 740                        "content": result_text,
 741                        "is_error": is_error,
 742                    }
 743                )
 744
 745        return {
 746            "task": text,
 747            "result": (
 748                "I could not complete that Home Assistant request within "
 749                f"{self._other_tool_max_rounds} tool rounds."
 750            ),
 751            "error": "tool_round_limit",
 752        }
 753
 754    # ── Device discovery ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 755
 756    async def _get_devices(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
 757        now = time.time()
 758        cached = self._device_cache.get("data")
 759        if (
 760            cached is not None
 761            and now - float(self._device_cache.get("timestamp", 0.0)) < self._device_cache_ttl
 762        ):
 763            return cached
 764
 765        if not self.ha_url or not self.ha_token:
 766            data: dict[str, Any] = {
 767                "connected": False,
 768                "data": {},
 769                "reason": "HOME_ASSISTANT_URL or HOME_ASSISTANT_TOKEN is not configured",
 770            }
 771            self._device_cache = {"timestamp": now, "data": data}
 772            return data
 773
 774        try:
 775            ha_data = await get_simplified_ha_data(self.ha_url, self.ha_token)
 776            if not isinstance(ha_data, dict):
 777                logger.warning(
 778                    "[%s] get_simplified_ha_data returned unexpected type %s",
 779                    self.name,
 780                    type(ha_data),
 781                )
 782                ha_data = {}
 783            data = {"connected": True, "data": ha_data, "reason": ""}
 784            self._device_cache = {"timestamp": now, "data": data}
 785            return data
 786        except Exception as exc:
 787            data = {
 788                "connected": False,
 789                "data": {},
 790                "reason": f"Could not query Home Assistant devices: {exc}",
 791            }
 792            self._device_cache = {"timestamp": now, "data": data}
 793            return data
 794
 795    async def _fetch_registry_items(self, fetcher: Any) -> tuple[list[dict[str, Any]], str | None]:
 796        """Fetch HA registry data with common config and error handling."""
 797        if not self.ha_url or not self.ha_token:
 798            return [], "HA_URL or HA_TOKEN not configured."
 799        try:
 800            items = await fetcher(self.ha_url, self.ha_token)
 801            if not isinstance(items, list):
 802                items = []
 803            return items, None
 804        except Exception as exc:
 805            logger.warning("[%s] Could not fetch Home Assistant registry data: %s", self.name, exc)
 806            return [], f"Could not fetch data from Home Assistant: {exc}"
 807
 808    async def _list_areas(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
 809        areas, error = await self._fetch_registry_items(get_areas)
 810        if error:
 811            return {"result": error, "areas": []}
 812        if not areas:
 813            return {"result": "No areas found in Home Assistant.", "areas": []}
 814
 815        area_rows = [
 816            {
 817                "area_id": str(a.get("area_id", "")),
 818                "name": str(a.get("name") or "(unnamed)"),
 819            }
 820            for a in areas
 821            if isinstance(a, dict)
 822        ]
 823        lines = [f"Found {len(area_rows)} area(s) in Home Assistant:"]
 824        for idx, row in enumerate(area_rows, 1):
 825            lines.append(f"{idx}. {row['name']} ({row['area_id']})")
 826        return {"result": "\n".join(lines), "areas": area_rows}
 827
 828    async def _list_devices(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
 829        devices, error = await self._fetch_registry_items(get_devices)
 830        if error:
 831            return {"result": error, "devices": []}
 832        if not devices:
 833            return {"result": "No devices found in Home Assistant.", "devices": []}
 834
 835        device_rows = [
 836            {
 837                "device_id": str(d.get("id", "")),
 838                "name": str(d.get("name_by_user") or d.get("name") or "(unnamed)"),
 839                "manufacturer": str(d.get("manufacturer") or ""),
 840                "model": str(d.get("model") or ""),
 841            }
 842            for d in devices
 843            if isinstance(d, dict)
 844        ]
 845        lines = [f"Found {len(device_rows)} device(s) in Home Assistant:"]
 846        for idx, row in enumerate(device_rows, 1):
 847            details = " ".join(p for p in (row["manufacturer"], row["model"]) if p).strip()
 848            if details:
 849                lines.append(f"{idx}. {row['name']} ({details})")
 850            else:
 851                lines.append(f"{idx}. {row['name']}")
 852        return {"result": "\n".join(lines), "devices": device_rows}
 853
 854    async def _list_entities(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
 855        entities, error = await self._fetch_registry_items(get_entities)
 856        if error:
 857            return {"result": error, "entities": []}
 858        if not entities:
 859            return {"result": "No entities found in Home Assistant.", "entities": []}
 860
 861        entity_rows = [
 862            {
 863                "entity_id": str(e.get("entity_id", "")),
 864                "name": str(e.get("name") or e.get("original_name") or "(unnamed)"),
 865                "platform": str(e.get("platform") or ""),
 866            }
 867            for e in entities
 868            if isinstance(e, dict) and e.get("disabled_by") is None
 869        ]
 870        lines = [f"Found {len(entity_rows)} entities in Home Assistant:"]
 871        for idx, row in enumerate(entity_rows, 1):
 872            if row["platform"]:
 873                lines.append(f"{idx}. {row['entity_id']} ({row['platform']})")
 874            else:
 875                lines.append(f"{idx}. {row['entity_id']}")
 876        return {"result": "\n".join(lines), "entities": entity_rows}
