 878    # ── Hardware selection ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 879    # NOTE: _select_hardware, _format_hardware_result, and _extract_entity_ids_from_hardware
 880    # are currently unused — the create_automation flow is temporarily disabled in _process.
 881
 882    async def _select_hardware(self, text: str, devices: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
 883        """LLM-backed hardware selection. Returns a formatted hardware result dict."""
 884        if self.llm is None:
 885            return self._format_hardware_result(
 886                text, devices, [], False, "No LLM provider configured."
 887            )
 888
 889        dev_list = devices.get("data", {}).get("devices", []) or []
 890        payload = {
 891            "user_request": text,
 892            "device_discovery": {
 893                "connected": bool(devices.get("connected")),
 894                "reason": devices.get("reason", ""),
 895                "domains": sorted(devices.get("domains", set()) or set()),
 896                "devices": dev_list,
 897            },
 898        }
 899
 900        user_msg = {"role": "user", "content": json.dumps(payload)}
 901        try:
 902            response, usage = await self.llm.complete(
 903                messages=[user_msg], system=HARDWARE_SELECTION_PROMPT
 904            )
 905            self._accumulate_usage(usage)
 906            data = json.loads(self._strip_fences(response))
 907            if not isinstance(data, dict):
 908                raise ValueError("LLM response is not a JSON object")
 909
 910            selected: list[dict[str, Any]] = data.get("hardware") or []
 911            if not isinstance(selected, list):
 912                selected = []
 913            can_fulfill = bool(data.get("can_fulfill"))
 914            fallback_text = str(data.get("result", "")).strip()
 915
 916            # Self-correction: can_fulfill=true but empty hardware list
 917            if can_fulfill and not selected:
 918                correction = {
 919                    "role": "user",
 920                    "content": (
 921                        "Your previous JSON is invalid: can_fulfill=true but hardware is empty. "
 922                        "Return corrected JSON only. Either provide at least one hardware item "
 923                        "or set can_fulfill=false."
 924                    ),
 925                }
 926                retry, usage = await self.llm.complete(
 927                    messages=[user_msg, {"role": "assistant", "content": response}, correction],
 928                    system=HARDWARE_SELECTION_PROMPT,
 929                )
 930                self._accumulate_usage(usage)
 931                retry_data = json.loads(self._strip_fences(retry))
 932                if isinstance(retry_data, dict):
 933                    selected = retry_data.get("hardware") or []
 934                    if not isinstance(selected, list):
 935                        selected = []
 936                    can_fulfill = bool(retry_data.get("can_fulfill"))
 937                    fallback_text = str(retry_data.get("result", "")).strip()
 938
 939            if can_fulfill and not selected:
 940                can_fulfill = False
 941                fallback_text = "LLM response was inconsistent (can_fulfill=true with empty hardware). Please retry."
 942
 943            return self._format_hardware_result(text, devices, selected, can_fulfill, fallback_text)
 944
 945        except Exception as exc:
 946            logger.error("[%s] Hardware selection failed: %s", self.name, exc, exc_info=True)
 947            return self._format_hardware_result(
 948                text, devices, [], False, f"Hardware selection error: {exc}"
 949            )
 950
 951    async def _recommend_hardware(self, text: str, devices: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
 952        """Entry point for pure hardware-recommendation requests."""
 953        connected = bool(devices.get("connected"))
 954        available_entities = self._available_entity_ids(devices)
 955
 956        if not connected:
 957            reason = str(devices.get("reason", "Device discovery unavailable.")).strip()
 958            return self._format_available_hardware_result(
 959                text,
 960                devices,
 961                [],
 962                [],
 963                False,
 964                reason or "Device discovery unavailable.",
 965            )
 966
 967        if self.llm is None:
 968            return self._format_available_hardware_result(
 969                text,
 970                devices,
 971                [],
 972                [],
 973                False,
 974                "No LLM provider configured.",
 975            )
 976
 977        payload = {
 978            "user_request": text,
 979            "device_discovery": {
 980                "connected": connected,
 981                "reason": devices.get("reason", ""),
 982                "devices": devices.get("data", {}).get("devices", []) or [],
 983                "entities": devices.get("data", {}).get("entities", []) or [],
 984                "floors": devices.get("data", {}).get("floors", []) or [],
 985                "areas": devices.get("data", {}).get("areas", []) or [],
 986            },
 987        }
 988        user_msg = {"role": "user", "content": json.dumps(payload)}
 989
 990        try:
 991            response, usage = await self.llm.complete(
 992                messages=[user_msg],
 993                system=HARDWARE_RECOMMENDATION_PROMPT,
 994            )
 995            logger.info("[%s] Received hardware recommendation response from LLM.", self.name)
 996            self._accumulate_usage(usage)
 997            data = json.loads(self._strip_fences(response))
 998            if not isinstance(data, dict):
 999                raise ValueError("LLM response is not a JSON object")
1000
1001            primary = self._normalize_available_hardware_items(
1002                data.get("primary_hardware") or [],
1003                available_entities,
1004            )
1005            alternatives = self._normalize_available_hardware_items(
1006                data.get("alternatives") or [],
1007                available_entities,
1008            )
1009            alternatives = self._filter_hardware_alternatives(primary, alternatives)
1010            can_fulfill = bool(data.get("can_fulfill"))
1011            fallback_text = str(data.get("result", "")).strip()
1012
1013            if can_fulfill and not primary:
1014                correction = {
1015                    "role": "user",
1016                    "content": (
1017                        "Your previous JSON is invalid: can_fulfill=true but primary_hardware is empty or not grounded in discovered entities. "
1018                        "Return corrected JSON only. Either provide at least one valid primary_hardware item with discovered entity_ids or set can_fulfill=false."
1019                    ),
1020                }
1021                retry, usage = await self.llm.complete(
1022                    messages=[user_msg, {"role": "assistant", "content": response}, correction],
1023                    system=HARDWARE_RECOMMENDATION_PROMPT,
1024                )
1025                self._accumulate_usage(usage)
1026                retry_data = json.loads(self._strip_fences(retry))
1027                if isinstance(retry_data, dict):
1028                    primary = self._normalize_available_hardware_items(
1029                        retry_data.get("primary_hardware") or [],
1030                        available_entities,
1031                    )
1032                    alternatives = self._normalize_available_hardware_items(
1033                        retry_data.get("alternatives") or [],
1034                        available_entities,
1035                    )
1036                    alternatives = self._filter_hardware_alternatives(primary, alternatives)
1037                    can_fulfill = bool(retry_data.get("can_fulfill"))
1038                    fallback_text = str(retry_data.get("result", "")).strip()
1039
1040            if can_fulfill and not primary:
1041                can_fulfill = False
1042                fallback_text = (
1043                    fallback_text
1044                    or "No grounded hardware recommendations could be verified from the discovered entities."
1045                )
1046
1047            return self._format_available_hardware_result(
1048                text,
1049                devices,
1050                primary,
1051                alternatives,
1052                can_fulfill,
1053                fallback_text,
1054            )
1055
1056        except Exception as exc:
1057            logger.error("[%s] Hardware recommendation failed: %s", self.name, exc, exc_info=True)
1058            return self._format_available_hardware_result(
1059                text,
1060                devices,
1061                [],
1062                [],
1063                False,
1064                f"Hardware recommendation error: {exc}",
1065            )
1066
1067    def _format_available_hardware_result(
1068        self,
1069        text: str,
1070        devices: dict[str, Any],
1071        primary_hardware: list[dict[str, Any]],
1072        alternatives: list[dict[str, Any]],
1073        can_fulfill: bool,
1074        fallback_text: str = "",
1075    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
1076        connected = bool(devices.get("connected"))
1077        has_primary = bool(primary_hardware)
1078
1079        lines = [
1080            f"Can be done with existing hardware: {'yes' if can_fulfill and has_primary else 'no'}."
1081        ]
1082        if has_primary:
1083            lines.append("Primary hardware:")
1084            lines.extend(self._hardware_summary_lines(primary_hardware))
1085            if alternatives:
1086                lines.append("Alternatives:")
1087                lines.extend(self._hardware_summary_lines(alternatives))
1088            if can_fulfill:
1089                lines.append(
1090                    "Recommendations are grounded only in currently discovered Home Assistant entities."
1091                )
1092            elif fallback_text:
1093                lines.append(fallback_text)
1094            else:
1095                lines.append(
1096                    "The selected hardware covers only part of the request based on currently discovered Home Assistant entities."
1097                )
1098        else:
1099            lines.append(
1100                fallback_text
1101                or (
1102                    "No combination of the currently discovered hardware can satisfy this request."
1103                    if connected
1104                    else "Device discovery unavailable."
1105                )
1106            )
1107            if alternatives:
1108                lines.append("Other related available hardware:")
1109                lines.extend(self._hardware_summary_lines(alternatives))
1110
1111        return {
1112            "can_fulfill": bool(can_fulfill and has_primary),
1113            "task": text,
1114            "request": text,
1115            "hardware": primary_hardware,
1116            "primary_hardware": primary_hardware,
1117            "alternatives": alternatives,
1118            "based_on_available_hardware": connected,
1119            "result": "\n".join(lines),
1120            "device_discovery": {"connected": connected, "reason": devices.get("reason", "")},
1121        }
1122
1123    def _format_hardware_result(
1124        self,
1125        text: str,
1126        devices: dict[str, Any],
1127        hardware: list[dict[str, Any]],
1128        can_fulfill: bool,
1129        fallback_text: str = "",
1130    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
1131        connected = bool(devices.get("connected"))
1132
1133        if not can_fulfill or not hardware:
1134            cannot = fallback_text or (
1135                "I found Home Assistant devices, but none are relevant to this automation request."
1136                if connected
1137                else "HOME_ASSISTANT_URL or HA_TOKEN not configured; cannot discover devices."
1138            )
1139            return {
1140                "can_fulfill": False,
1141                "task": text,
1142                "request": text,
1143                "hardware": [],
1144                "result": cannot,
1145                "device_discovery": {"connected": connected, "reason": devices.get("reason", "")},
1146            }
1147
1148        lines = ["Best hardware for this automation:"]
1149        for rec in hardware:
1150            line = f"- {rec.get('hardware', '?')} ({rec.get('protocol', 'N/A')}) — {rec.get('why', '')}"
1151            entities_list = rec.get("required_entities") or []
1152            if connected and isinstance(entities_list, list) and entities_list:
1153                shown = [str(e) for e in entities_list[:3]]
1154                line += f"  Available: {', '.join(shown)}"
1155            lines.append(line)
1156
1157        if connected:
1158            lines.append("Based on currently discovered Home Assistant entities.")
1159        else:
1160            lines.append(f"Device discovery unavailable: {devices.get('reason', 'N/A')}.")
1161
1162        return {
1163            "can_fulfill": True,
1164            "task": text,
1165            "request": text,
1166            "hardware": hardware,
1167            "result": "\n".join(lines),
1168            "device_discovery": {"connected": connected, "reason": devices.get("reason", "")},
1169        }
1170
1171    # ── Automation creation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
1172
1173    async def _create_automation(
1174        self,
1175        text: str,
1176        entities: list[str],
1177        hardware: list[dict[str, Any]],
1178    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
1179        try:
1180            generated = await self._generate_automation(text, entities, hardware)
1181            if not generated.get("can_create"):
1182                return {
1183                    "can_create": False,
1184                    "inserted": False,
1185                    "result": generated.get("result", "Could not create automation."),
1186                    "automation": {},
1187                }
1188
1189            automation = generated["automation"]
1190            insert_result = await self._insert_automation(automation)
1191            if not insert_result.get("inserted"):
1192                return {
1193                    "can_create": True,
1194                    "inserted": False,
1195                    "result": (
1196                        f"Automation plan created but failed to insert into Home Assistant: "
1197                        f"{insert_result.get('error', 'unknown error')}"
1198                    ),
1199                    "automation": automation,
1200                }
1201
1202            return {
1203                "can_create": True,
1204                "inserted": True,
1205                "result": f"Automation '{automation.get('name', 'Generated automation')}' created in Home Assistant.",
1206                "automation": automation,
1207                "home_assistant": insert_result.get("response"),
1208            }
1209
1210        except Exception as exc:
1211            logger.error("[%s] Automation creation failed: %s", self.name, exc, exc_info=True)
1212            return {
1213                "can_create": False,
1214                "inserted": False,
1215                "result": f"Failed to create automation: {exc}",
1216                "automation": {},
1217            }
1218
1219    async def _generate_automation(
1220        self,
1221        text: str,
1222        entities: list[str],
1223        hardware: list[dict[str, Any]],
1224    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
1225        if self.llm is None:
1226            return {"can_create": False, "result": "No LLM provider configured.", "automation": {}}
1227
1228        payload = {
1229            "user_request": text,
1230            "selected_entities": entities,
1231            "hardware_context": hardware,
1232        }
1233        response, usage = await self.llm.complete(
1234            messages=[{"role": "user", "content": json.dumps(payload)}],
1235            system=AUTOMATION_CREATION_PROMPT,
1236        )
1237        self._accumulate_usage(usage)
1238        data = json.loads(self._strip_fences(response))
1239        if not isinstance(data, dict):
1240            raise ValueError("LLM response is not a JSON object")
1241
1242        can_create = bool(data.get("can_create"))
1243        automation = data.get("automation") or {}
1244        result_text = str(data.get("result", "")).strip()
1245
1246        if not can_create:
1247            return {
1248                "can_create": False,
1249                "result": result_text or "Not enough information to safely create an automation.",
1250                "automation": {},
1251            }
1252
1253        if not isinstance(automation, dict):
1254            raise ValueError("automation must be a JSON object")
1255
1256        error = self._validate_automation(automation)
1257        if error:
1258            raise ValueError(error)
1259
1260        return {
1261            "can_create": True,
1262            "result": result_text or "Automation ready.",
1263            "automation": {
1264                "name": automation.get("name", "Generated automation"),
1265                "description": automation.get("description", "Generated by home-assistant-agent"),
1266                "trigger": automation.get("trigger", []),
1267                "condition": automation.get("condition", []),
1268                "action": automation.get("action", []),
1269                "mode": automation.get("mode", "single"),
1270            },
1271        }
1272
1273    async def _insert_automation(self, automation: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
1274        if not self.ha_url or not self.ha_token:
1275            return {"inserted": False, "error": "HA_URL or HA_TOKEN not configured"}
1276        try:
1277            response = await create_automation_via_rest(self.ha_url, self.ha_token, automation)
1278            return {"inserted": True, "response": response}
1279        except Exception as exc:
1280            return {"inserted": False, "error": str(exc)}
1281
1282    # ── Automation listing ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
1283
1284    async def _get_automations_brief(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
1285        """Return a brief list (id, name, description) with caching."""
1286        now = time.time()
1287        cached = self._automation_cache.get("data")
1288        if (
1289            cached is not None
1290            and now - float(self._automation_cache.get("timestamp", 0.0))
1291            < self._automation_cache_ttl
1292        ):
1293            return cached
1294
1295        if not self.ha_url or not self.ha_token:
1296            self._automation_cache = {"timestamp": now, "data": []}
1297            return []
1298
1299        try:
1300            full = await get_automations(self.ha_url, self.ha_token)
1301            brief = [
1302                {
1303                    "id": a.get("id", "") or a.get("automation_id", ""),
1304                    "name": a.get("alias", "") or a.get("name", ""),
1305                    "description": a.get("description", ""),
1306                }
1307                for a in (full or [])
1308                if isinstance(a, dict)
1309            ]
1310            self._automation_cache = {"timestamp": now, "data": brief}
1311            return brief
1312        except Exception as exc:
1313            logger.warning("[%s] Could not fetch automations: %s", self.name, exc)
1314            self._automation_cache = {"timestamp": now, "data": []}
1315            return []
1316
1317    def _list_automations(self, automations: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
1318        if not automations:
1319            suffix = " (or Home Assistant is not configured)." if not self.ha_url else "."
1320            return {"result": f"No automations found in Home Assistant{suffix}", "automations": []}
1321
1322        lines = [f"Found {len(automations)} automation(s) in Home Assistant:"]
1323        for i, a in enumerate(automations, 1):
1324            name = a.get("name") or "(unnamed)"
1325            desc = a.get("description") or ""
1326            line = f"{i}. {name}"
1327            if desc:
1328                line += f" — {desc}"
1329            lines.append(line)
1330
1331        return {"result": "\n".join(lines), "automations": automations}
1332
1333    # ── Automation deletion ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
1334
1335    async def _delete_automation(
1336        self,
1337        text: str,
1338        automations: list[dict[str, Any]],
1339    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
1340        if not automations:
1341            return {"result": "No automations found in Home Assistant to delete.", "deleted": False}
1342        if self.llm is None:
1343            return {"result": "No LLM provider configured.", "deleted": False}
1344
1345        payload = {"user_request": text, "automations": automations}
1346        try:
1347            response, usage = await self.llm.complete(
1348                messages=[{"role": "user", "content": json.dumps(payload)}],
1349                system=HA_DELETE_CONFIRM_PROMPT,
1350            )
1351            self._accumulate_usage(usage)
1352            data = json.loads(self._strip_fences(response))
1353        except Exception as exc:
1354            return {"result": f"Could not identify automation to delete: {exc}", "deleted": False}
1355
1356        if not isinstance(data, dict):
1357            return {"result": "Could not identify which automation to delete.", "deleted": False}
1358        if not data.get("found"):
1359            return {
1360                "result": str(data.get("result", "Could not identify which automation to delete.")),
1361                "deleted": False,
1362            }
1363
1364        automation_id = str(data.get("automation_id", "")).strip()
1365        automation_name = str(data.get("automation_name", "")).strip()
1366
1367        if not automation_id:
1368            return {"result": "Could not determine automation ID to delete.", "deleted": False}
1369        if not self.ha_url or not self.ha_token:
1370            return {"result": "HA_URL or HA_TOKEN not configured.", "deleted": False}
1371
1372        try:
1373            success = await delete_automation(self.ha_url, self.ha_token, automation_id)
1374            if success:
1375                self._automation_cache = {"timestamp": 0.0, "data": None}  # invalidate
1376                return {
1377                    "result": f"Automation '{automation_name}' deleted successfully.",
1378                    "deleted": True,
1379                    "automation_id": automation_id,
1380                    "automation_name": automation_name,
1381                }
1382            return {
1383                "result": f"Failed to delete automation '{automation_name}'. Home Assistant returned an error.",
1384                "deleted": False,
1385            }
1386        except Exception as exc:
1387            return {"result": f"Error deleting automation: {exc}", "deleted": False}
1388
1389    # ── Automation editing ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
1390
1391    async def _identify_automation(
1392        self,
1393        text: str,
1394        automations: list[dict[str, Any]],
1395    ) -> tuple[str, str]:
1396        """Identify which automation the user wants to edit based on their request and the list of automations."""
1397        ident_payload = {"user_request": text, "automations": automations}
1398        llm = self.llm
1399        if llm is None:
1400            return "", "No LLM provider is configured, so the automation cannot be identified."
1401        try:
1402            ident_response, usage = await llm.complete(
1403                messages=[{"role": "user", "content": json.dumps(ident_payload)}],
1404                system=HA_IDENTIFY_AUTOMATION_PROMPT,
1405            )
1406            self._accumulate_usage(usage)
1407            ident_data = json.loads(self._strip_fences(ident_response))
1408        except Exception as exc:
1409            raise AutomationEditError(f"Could not identify automation to edit: {exc}") from exc
1410
1411        if not isinstance(ident_data, dict):
1412            raise AutomationEditError("Could not identify which automation to edit.")
1413        if not ident_data.get("found"):
1414            raise AutomationEditError(
1415                str(ident_data.get("result", "Could not identify which automation to edit."))
1416            )
1417
1418        automation_id = str(ident_data.get("automation_id", "")).strip()
1419        automation_name = str(ident_data.get("automation_name", "")).strip()
1420
1421        if not automation_id:
1422            raise AutomationEditError("Could not determine the automation ID to edit.")
1423
1424        return automation_id, automation_name
1425
1426    async def _get_automation_config(
1427        self, automation_id: str, automation_name: str
1428    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
1429        """Fetch the full automation config for a given automation ID."""
1430        try:
1431            full_list = await get_automations(self.ha_url, self.ha_token)
1432            match = next(
1433                (
1434                    a
1435                    for a in (full_list or [])
1436                    if isinstance(a, dict)
1437                    and (a.get("id") == automation_id or a.get("alias") == automation_name)
1438                ),
1439                None,
1440            )
1441            if isinstance(match, dict):
1442                return match
1443            return {}
1444        except Exception as exc:
1445            logger.warning("[%s] Could not fetch full automation config: %s", self.name, exc)
1446            return {}
1447
1448    async def _generate_modified_automation_config(
1449        self,
1450        text: str,
1451        existing_config: dict[str, Any],
1452        entity_ids: list[str],
1453    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
1454        """Generate the updated automation config from the user's edit request."""
1455        edit_payload = {
1456            "user_request": text,
1457            "existing_automation": existing_config,
1458            "available_entities": entity_ids[:100],
1459        }
1460        llm = self.llm
1461        if llm is None:
1462            return {"error": "No LLM provider is configured, so the edit cannot be generated."}
1463        try:
1464            edit_response, usage = await llm.complete(
1465                messages=[{"role": "user", "content": json.dumps(edit_payload)}],
1466                system=HA_EDIT_AUTOMATION_PROMPT,
1467            )
1468            self._accumulate_usage(usage)
1469            edit_data = json.loads(self._strip_fences(edit_response))
1470        except Exception as exc:
1471            raise AutomationEditError(f"LLM could not generate updated automation: {exc}") from exc
1472
1473        if not isinstance(edit_data, dict):
1474            raise AutomationEditError("Invalid generated automation config.")
1475        if not edit_data.get("can_edit"):
1476            raise AutomationEditError(str(edit_data.get("result", "Automation cannot be edited.")))
1477        updated_automation = edit_data.get("automation") or {}
1478        if not isinstance(updated_automation, dict):
1479            raise AutomationEditError("Generated automation config must be an object.")
1480        return updated_automation
1481
1482    async def _edit_automation(
1483        self,
1484        text: str,
1485        automations: list[dict[str, Any]],
1486        devices: dict[str, Any],
1487    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
1488        if not automations:
1489            return {"result": "No automations found in Home Assistant to edit.", "edited": False}
1490        if self.llm is None:
1491            return {"result": "No LLM provider configured.", "edited": False}
1492        if not self.ha_url or not self.ha_token:
1493            return {"result": "HA_URL or HA_TOKEN not configured.", "edited": False}
1494
1495        # Step 1 — identify which automation the user wants to edit
1496        try:
1497            automation_id, automation_name = await self._identify_automation(text, automations)
1498        except AutomationEditError as exc:
1499            return {"result": str(exc), "edited": False}
1500
1501        # Fetch the full automation config for context
1502        existing_config: dict[str, Any] = {"id": automation_id, "alias": automation_name}
1503        fetched_config = await self._get_automation_config(automation_id, automation_name)
1504        if fetched_config:
1505            existing_config = fetched_config
1506        else:
1507            logger.warning(
1508                "[%s] Could not fetch full automation config for automation_id: %s, automation_name: %s",
1509                self.name,
1510                automation_id,
1511                automation_name,
1512            )
1513
1514        # Build flat entity list for context (cap to avoid huge prompts)
1515        entity_ids = self._entity_ids_from_devices(devices)
1516
1517        # Step 2 — LLM generates the updated automation
1518        try:
1519            updated_automation = await self._generate_modified_automation_config(
1520                text, existing_config, entity_ids
1521            )
1522        except AutomationEditError as exc:
1523            logger.warning("[%s] Could not generate updated automation: %s", self.name, exc)
1524            return {"result": str(exc), "edited": False}
1525
1526        error = self._validate_automation(updated_automation)
1527        if error:
1528            return {"result": f"Updated automation is invalid: {error}", "edited": False}
1529
1530        try:
1531            await update_automation(self.ha_url, self.ha_token, automation_id, updated_automation)
1532            self._automation_cache = {"timestamp": 0.0, "data": None}  # invalidate
1533            return {
1534                "result": f"Automation '{automation_name}' updated successfully.",
1535                "edited": True,
1536                "automation_id": automation_id,
1537                "automation_name": automation_name,
1538                "automation": updated_automation,
1539            }
1540        except Exception as exc:
1541            return {"result": f"Error updating automation: {exc}", "edited": False}
1542
1543    # ── Static helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
1544
1545    @staticmethod
1546    def _entity_ids_from_devices(devices: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
1547        return [
1548            e.get("entity_id")
1549            for e in devices.get("data", {}).get("entities", []) or []
1550            if e.get("entity_id")
1551        ]
1552
1553    @staticmethod
1554    def _extract_payload(payload: Any) -> tuple[str, list[str], list[dict[str, Any]]]:
1555        if isinstance(payload, dict):
1556            text = str(payload.get("text") or payload.get("task") or "").strip()
1557            entities = payload.get("entities") or []
1558            hardware = payload.get("hardware") or []
1559            if not isinstance(entities, list):
1560                entities = []
1561            if not isinstance(hardware, list):
1562                hardware = []
1563            entities = [str(e).strip() for e in entities if str(e).strip()]
1564            return text, entities, hardware
1565        return str(payload), [], []
1566
1567    @staticmethod
1568    def _extract_task_id(payload: Any, fallback: str) -> str:
1569        if isinstance(payload, dict) and isinstance(payload.get("task"), str):
1570            return payload["task"]
1571        return fallback
1572
1573    @staticmethod
1574    def _strip_fences(text: str) -> str:
1575        """Remove markdown code fences from an LLM response.
1576
1577        LLMs often wrap JSON output in triple-backtick fences (e.g. ```json ... ```).
1578        This strips the opening fence and optional language tag as well as the closing
1579        fence, returning only the inner content. If no fences are present the text is
1580        returned unchanged (after stripping surrounding whitespace).
1581        """
1582        cleaned = (text or "").strip()
1583        if cleaned.startswith("```"):
1584            cleaned = re.sub(r"^```[a-zA-Z]*", "", cleaned).strip()
1585            cleaned = re.sub(r"```$", "", cleaned).strip()
1586        return cleaned
1587
1588    @staticmethod
1589    def _validate_automation(automation: dict[str, Any]) -> str | None:
1590        if not isinstance(automation.get("name"), str) or not automation["name"].strip():
1591            return "automation.name is required"
1592        if not isinstance(automation.get("trigger"), list) or not automation["trigger"]:
1593            return "automation.trigger must be a non-empty list"
1594        if not isinstance(automation.get("action"), list) or not automation["action"]:
1595            return "automation.action must be a non-empty list"
1596        if not isinstance(automation.get("condition", []), list):
1597            return "automation.condition must be a list"
1598        if (
1599            not isinstance(automation.get("mode", "single"), str)
1600            or not automation.get("mode", "single").strip()
1601        ):
1602            return "automation.mode must be a non-empty string"
1603        return None
1604
1605    @staticmethod
1606    def _available_entity_ids(devices: dict[str, Any]) -> set[str]:
1607        """Extract the flat set of all entity IDs from a device-discovery result.
1608
1609        Walks ``devices["data"]["entities"]`` and collects every non-empty
1610        ``entity_id`` string. The resulting set is used as the ground-truth
1611        allowlist when normalizing LLM hardware recommendations, so that any
1612        entity ID the LLM invented but that is not present here gets discarded.
1613        """
1614        available: set[str] = set()
1615        for entity in devices.get("data", {}).get("entities", []) or []:
1616            if not isinstance(entity, dict):
1617                continue
1618            entity_id = str(entity.get("entity_id", "")).strip()
1619            if entity_id:
1620                available.add(entity_id)
1621        return available
1622
1623    @staticmethod
1624    def _normalize_available_hardware_items(
1625        items: list[dict[str, Any]],
1626        available_entities: set[str],
1627    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
1628        """Validate and sanitize raw LLM hardware items against discovered HA entities.
1629
1630        For each item returned by the LLM:
1631        - Keeps only ``required_entities`` that exist in ``available_entities``,
1632          discarding hallucinated entity IDs.
1633        - Drops the item entirely if no valid entities remain after filtering.
1634        - Derives ``required_domains`` from entity ID prefixes when the LLM omitted them.
1635        - Drops items that still lack a hardware name or resolvable domain.
1636        - Deduplicates by ``(hardware_name, entity_ids)`` to prevent repeated entries.
1637        - Normalises the output shape to a consistent set of fields.
1638
1639        The result is a clean, grounded list where every recommendation is backed
1640        by real, currently-discovered Home Assistant entities.
1641        """
1642        normalized: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
1643        seen: set[tuple[str, tuple[str, ...]]] = set()
1644
1645        for item in items:
1646            if not isinstance(item, dict):
1647                continue
1648
1649            entity_ids: list[str] = []
1650            for entity_id in item.get("required_entities", []) or []:
1651                normalized_entity = str(entity_id).strip()
1652                if (
1653                    normalized_entity
1654                    and normalized_entity in available_entities
1655                    and normalized_entity not in entity_ids
1656                ):
1657                    entity_ids.append(normalized_entity)
1658
1659            if not entity_ids:
1660                continue
1661
1662            hardware_name = str(item.get("hardware", "")).strip()
1663            why = str(item.get("why", "")).strip()
1664            protocol = str(item.get("protocol", "")).strip() or "N/A"
1665            required_domains = [
1666                str(domain).strip()
1667                for domain in item.get("required_domains", []) or []
1668                if str(domain).strip()
1669            ]
1670            if not required_domains:
1671                required_domains = sorted(
1672                    {entity_id.split(".", 1)[0] for entity_id in entity_ids if "." in entity_id}
1673                )
1674
1675            if not hardware_name or not required_domains:
1676                continue
1677
1678            identity = (hardware_name.lower(), tuple(entity_ids))
1679            if identity in seen:
1680                continue
1681            seen.add(identity)
1682            normalized.append(
1683                {
1684                    "hardware": hardware_name,
1685                    "why": why,
1686                    "protocol": protocol,
1687                    "required_domains": required_domains,
1688                    "required_entities": entity_ids,
1689                    **(
1690                        {"alternative_to": str(item.get("alternative_to", "")).strip()}
1691                        if str(item.get("alternative_to", "")).strip()
1692                        else {}
1693                    ),
1694                }
1695            )
1696
1697        return normalized
1698
1699    @staticmethod
1700    def _filter_hardware_alternatives(
1701        primary_hardware: list[dict[str, Any]],
1702        alternatives: list[dict[str, Any]],
1703    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
1704        """Remove alternatives that are not genuine substitutes for primary hardware.
1705
1706        An alternative survives only if all four conditions hold:
1707        - It has at least one ``required_entity``.
1708        - Its ``alternative_to`` field is non-empty and matches an entity ID that
1709          appears in ``primary_hardware`` — linking it to a specific primary item.
1710        - None of its own ``required_entities`` overlap with the primary entity set,
1711          preventing the LLM from re-listing a primary item as its own alternative.
1712        - Its ``(hardware_name, entity_ids)`` identity has not been seen before,
1713          removing duplicates.
1714
1715        The result is a deduplicated list of alternatives that each offer a distinct,
1716        non-overlapping swap for one of the recommended primary hardware items.
1717        """
1718        primary_entities = {
1719            str(entity_id).strip()
1720            for item in primary_hardware
1721            if isinstance(item, dict)
1722            for entity_id in item.get("required_entities", []) or []
1723            if str(entity_id).strip()
1724        }
1725        filtered: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
1726        seen: set[tuple[str, tuple[str, ...]]] = set()
1727
1728        for item in alternatives:
1729            if not isinstance(item, dict):
1730                continue
1731            alternative_to = str(item.get("alternative_to", "")).strip()
1732            entity_ids = [
1733                str(entity_id).strip()
1734                for entity_id in item.get("required_entities", []) or []
1735                if str(entity_id).strip()
1736            ]
1737            if (
1738                not entity_ids
1739                or not alternative_to
1740                or alternative_to not in primary_entities
1741                or any(entity_id in primary_entities for entity_id in entity_ids)
1742            ):
1743                continue
1744            identity = (str(item.get("hardware", "")).strip().lower(), tuple(entity_ids))
1745            if identity in seen:
1746                continue
1747            seen.add(identity)
1748            filtered.append(item)
1749
1750        return filtered
1751
1752    @staticmethod
1753    def _hardware_summary_lines(items: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[str]:
1754        lines: list[str] = []
1755        for item in items:
1756            if not isinstance(item, dict):
1757                continue
1758            entities = [
1759                str(entity_id)
1760                for entity_id in item.get("required_entities", []) or []
1761                if str(entity_id)
1762            ]
1763            line = f"- {item.get('hardware', '?')} ({item.get('protocol', 'N/A')})"
1764            alternative_to = str(item.get("alternative_to", "")).strip()
1765            if alternative_to:
1766                line += f" [alternative to {alternative_to}]"
1767            why = str(item.get("why", "")).strip()
1768            if why:
1769                line += f" — {why}"
1770            if entities:
1771                line += f" Available: {', '.join(entities[:3])}"
1772            lines.append(line)
1773        return lines
1774
1775    @staticmethod
1776    def _extract_entity_ids_from_hardware(hardware_result: dict[str, Any]) -> list[str]:
1777        seen: set[str] = set()
1778        entities: list[str] = []
1779        for item in hardware_result.get("hardware", []) or []:
1780            if not isinstance(item, dict):
1781                continue
1782            for eid in item.get("required_entities", []) or []:
1783                normalized = str(eid).strip()
1784                if normalized and normalized not in seen:
1785                    seen.add(normalized)
1786                    entities.append(normalized)
1787        return entities
1788
1789    @staticmethod
1790    def _extract_entity_ids(text: str) -> list[str]:
1791        seen: set[str] = set()
1792        entity_ids: list[str] = []
1793        for match in re.finditer(r"\b[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*\.[a-z0-9_]+\b", text.lower()):
1794            entity_id = match.group(0)
1795            if entity_id not in seen:
1796                seen.add(entity_id)
1797                entity_ids.append(entity_id)
1798        return entity_ids

146    async def chat(self, user_message: str) -> str:
147        """Direct entry point used by CLI when addressing this agent."""
148        ts_user = time.time()
149        self._conversation_history.append({"role": "user", "content": user_message, "ts": ts_user})
150        result = await self._process(user_message)
151        response = str(result.get("result", ""))
152        ts_reply = time.time()
153        self._conversation_history.append(
154            {"role": "assistant", "content": response, "ts": ts_reply}
155        )
156        await self._maybe_summarize()
157        self.persist("conversation_history", self._conversation_history)
158        self._log_chat_turn(user_message, response, ts_user=ts_user, ts_reply=ts_reply)
159        return response

169    async def handle_message(self, msg: Message) -> None:
170        if msg.type != MessageType.TASK:
171            return
172
173        text, entities, hardware = self._extract_payload(msg.payload)
174
175        operation = msg.payload.get("operation") if isinstance(msg.payload, dict) else None
176        camera_entity_id = (
177            str(msg.payload.get("camera_entity_id", "")).strip()
178            if isinstance(msg.payload, dict)
179            else ""
180        )
181
182        if operation:
183            logger.debug(
184                f"[{self.name}] operation={operation} camera_entity_id={camera_entity_id!r} from={msg.sender_id}"
185            )
186
187        if operation == "list_cameras":
188            result = await self._list_cameras()
189        elif operation == "get_camera_snapshot":
190            result = await self._camera_snapshot(camera_entity_id)
191        elif operation == "get_camera_stream_url":
192            result = await self._camera_stream_url(camera_entity_id)
193        elif operation == "get_camera_snapshot_url":
194            result = await self._camera_snapshot_url(camera_entity_id)
195        elif operation == "get_history":
196            result = await self._get_history(msg.payload if isinstance(msg.payload, dict) else {})
197        elif entities or hardware:
198            # Pre-selected entities/hardware provided (e.g. direct API call) — skip
199            # classification and go straight to automation creation.
200            result = await self._create_automation(text, entities, hardware)
201        else:
202            result = await self._process(text)
203
204        if isinstance(result, dict):
205            result.setdefault("task", self._extract_task_id(msg.payload, text))
206            # Echo _task_id so planner futures resolve correctly
207            if isinstance(msg.payload, dict) and msg.payload.get("_task_id"):
208                result["_task_id"] = msg.payload["_task_id"]
209
210        self.metrics.tasks_completed += 1
211        if msg.sender_id:
212            await self.send(msg.sender_id, MessageType.RESULT, result)

159class HomeAssistantMapAgent(Actor):
160    """Listens for Home Assistant entity registry updates and republishes device maps."""
161
162    def __init__(self, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
163        kwargs.setdefault("name", "home-assistant-map-agent")
164        super().__init__(**kwargs)
165        self.protected = False
166        self.ha_url = (os.getenv("HOME_ASSISTANT_URL") or CONFIG.ha_url or "").rstrip("/")
167        self.ha_ws_url = normalize_ha_ws_url(self.ha_url)
168        self.ha_token = (os.getenv("HOME_ASSISTANT_TOKEN") or CONFIG.ha_token or "").strip()
169        self._output_topic = (
170            os.getenv("HA_MAP_AGENT_OUTPUT_TOPIC")
171            or os.getenv("HOME_ASSISTANT_MAP_OUTPUT_TOPIC")
172            or DEFAULT_OUTPUT_TOPIC
173        ).strip()
174        self._target_actor_name = (
175            os.getenv("HA_MAP_AGENT_TARGET_ACTOR")
176            or os.getenv("HOME_ASSISTANT_MAP_TARGET_ACTOR")
177            or ""
178        ).strip()
179        self._dispatcher = MapUpdateDispatcher(
180            agent=self,
181            mqtt_topic=self._output_topic,
182            target_actor_name=self._target_actor_name,
183        )
184        self._latest_map_payload: dict[str, Any] | None = None
185        self._events_seen = 0
186        self._last_event_at = 0.0
187        self._last_error = ""
188
189    async def on_start(self) -> None:
190        self._events_seen = int(self.recall("events_seen", 0))
191        self._last_event_at = float(self.recall("last_event_at", 0.0))
192        self._last_error = str(self.recall("last_error", ""))
193        latest = self.recall("latest_map_payload", None)
194        self._latest_map_payload = latest if isinstance(latest, dict) else None
195        await self._mqtt_publish(
196            f"agents/{self.actor_id}/spawn",
197            {
198                "agentId": self.actor_id,
199                "agentName": self.name,
200                "agentType": "home-assistant-map",
201                "timestamp": time.time(),
202            },
203        )
204        self._tasks.append(asyncio.create_task(self._entity_registry_listener()))
205        await self._initial_refresh()
206        logger.info("[%s] started", self.name)
207
208    async def on_stop(self) -> None:
209        self.persist("events_seen", self._events_seen)
210        self.persist("last_event_at", self._last_event_at)
211        self.persist("last_error", self._last_error)
212
213    async def handle_message(self, msg: Message) -> None:
214        if msg.type != MessageType.TASK:
215            return
216
217        command = self._extract_command(msg.payload)
218        if command == "status":
219            payload = self._build_status_payload()
220        elif command == "refresh":
221            payload = await self._refresh_map_payload(event=None)
222        elif command == "refresh simple":
223            payload = await self._refresh_map_payload(event=None, include_states=False)
224        else:
225            payload = {
226                "result": (
227                    "I cannot answer questions. I keep a map of the Home Assistant "
228                    "entities and where they are, and I understand 'status', 'refresh' "
229                    "and 'refresh simple'."
230                ),
231                "error": "Unsupported command. Use 'status', 'refresh', or 'refresh simple'.",
232                "supported_commands": ["status", "refresh", "refresh simple"],
233            }
234            self.metrics.tasks_failed += 1
235
236        # See the state bridge for why `result` is added rather than assumed:
237        # a reply without a key the chat can read is shown as a Python repr.
238        if isinstance(payload, dict) and "result" not in payload:
239            payload["result"] = self._spoken_status(payload)
240        if msg.sender_id:
241            await self.send(msg.sender_id, MessageType.RESULT, payload)
242
243    def _spoken_status(self, status: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
244        """The map's state as a sentence, for a person who asked."""
245        if not status.get("configured"):
246            return (
247                "I keep a map of the Home Assistant entities and where they are, "
248                "but no instance is configured, so the map is empty."
249            )
250        seen = status.get("events_seen", 0)
251        problem = status.get("last_error")
252        trouble = f" The last thing to go wrong: {problem}." if problem else ""
253        return (
254            f"I keep a map of the Home Assistant entities and where they are, and "
255            f"publish it to {status.get('output_topic')}. The registry has changed "
256            f"{seen} time{'' if seen == 1 else 's'} since I started.{trouble}"
257        )
258
259    def _extract_command(self, payload: Any) -> str:
260        if isinstance(payload, dict):
261            text = payload.get("text") or payload.get("task") or payload.get("command") or ""
262        else:
263            text = payload
264        return str(text or "").strip().lower()
265
266    async def _entity_registry_listener(self) -> None:
267        if not self.ha_url or not self.ha_ws_url or not self.ha_token:
268            self._last_error = (
269                "HA_URL/HOME_ASSISTANT_URL or HA_TOKEN/HOME_ASSISTANT_TOKEN is not configured"
270            )
271            logger.warning("[%s] %s", self.name, self._last_error)
272            return
273
274        while self.state not in (ActorState.STOPPED, ActorState.FAILED):
275            try:
276                async with HAWebSocketClient(self.ha_ws_url, self.ha_token) as ha:
277                    subscription_id = await ha.subscribe_events(ENTITY_REGISTRY_UPDATED_EVENT)
278                    self._last_error = ""
279                    logger.info(
280                        "[%s] subscribed to Home Assistant '%s' events",
281                        self.name,
282                        ENTITY_REGISTRY_UPDATED_EVENT,
283                    )
284
285                    while self.state not in (ActorState.STOPPED, ActorState.FAILED):
286                        event_message = await ha.receive_event(subscription_id)
287                        await self._handle_entity_registry_event(event_message)
288            except asyncio.CancelledError:
289                break
290            except Exception as exc:
291                self._last_error = str(exc)
292                logger.warning("[%s] listener error: %s", self.name, exc)
293                if self.state not in (ActorState.STOPPED, ActorState.FAILED):
294                    await asyncio.sleep(5)
295
296    async def _handle_entity_registry_event(self, event_message: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
297        await self._refresh_map_payload(event_message.get("event"), record_event=True)
298
299    async def _build_map_update_payload(
300        self,
301        event: dict[str, Any] | None,
302        include_states: bool = True,
303    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
304        devices = await fetch_devices_entities_with_location(
305            self.ha_url,
306            self.ha_token,
307            include_states=include_states,
308        )
309        return {
310            "type": "home_assistant_map_update",
311            "event_type": ENTITY_REGISTRY_UPDATED_EVENT,
312            "timestamp": time.time(),
313            "event": event or {},
314            "devices": devices,
315        }
316
317    def _store_latest_map_payload(self, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
318        self._latest_map_payload = payload
319        self.persist("latest_map_payload", payload)
320
321    def get_latest_map_payload(self) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
322        return self._latest_map_payload
323
324    async def _initial_refresh(self) -> None:
325        if not self.ha_url or not self.ha_ws_url or not self.ha_token:
326            return
327        try:
328            await self._warm_latest_map_payload()
329        # Exception only (not Cancellation), deliberately. Nothing here cancels a task of its own,
330        # so a CancelledError arriving is the *caller's* — this runs inside
331        # `on_start`, and turning a shutdown into a logged warning would let
332        # start-up carry on believing it had never been interrupted.
333        except Exception as exc:
334            self._last_error = str(exc)
335            logger.warning("[%s] initial refresh failed: %s", self.name, exc)
336
337    async def _warm_latest_map_payload(
338        self,
339        event: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
340        include_states: bool = True,
341    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
342        payload = await self._build_map_update_payload(
343            event=event,
344            include_states=include_states,
345        )
346        self._store_latest_map_payload(payload)
347        self._last_error = ""
348        self.metrics.tasks_completed += 1
349        return payload
350
351    async def _refresh_map_payload(
352        self,
353        event: dict[str, Any] | None,
354        include_states: bool = True,
355        record_event: bool = False,
356    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
357        payload = await self._warm_latest_map_payload(
358            event=event,
359            include_states=include_states,
360        )
361        await self._dispatcher.dispatch(payload)
362        if record_event:
363            self._events_seen += 1
364            self._last_event_at = payload["timestamp"]
365        return payload
366
367    def _build_status_payload(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
368        return {
369            "configured": bool(self.ha_url and self.ha_token),
370            "event_type": ENTITY_REGISTRY_UPDATED_EVENT,
371            "events_seen": self._events_seen,
372            "last_event_at": self._last_event_at,
373            "last_error": self._last_error,
374            "output_topic": self._output_topic,
375            "target_actor_name": self._target_actor_name,
376        }
377
378    def _current_task_description(self) -> str:
379        if self._last_error:
380            return f"waiting for HA events (error: {self._last_error})"
381        return f"watching {ENTITY_REGISTRY_UPDATED_EVENT} ({self._events_seen} seen)"

 26class HomeAssistantStateBridgeAgent(Actor):
 27    """Subscribes to Home Assistant state_changed events and publishes them to MQTT.
 28
 29    Configuration (environment variables):
 30        HA_URL / HOME_ASSISTANT_URL          — Home Assistant base URL
 31        HA_TOKEN / HOME_ASSISTANT_TOKEN      — Long-lived access token
 32        HA_STATE_BRIDGE_OUTPUT_TOPIC         — Base MQTT topic (default: homeassistant/state_changes)
 33        HA_STATE_BRIDGE_DOMAINS              — Comma-separated domain allow-list
 34                                               (e.g. "light,switch,sensor"). Empty = all domains.
 35        HA_STATE_BRIDGE_PER_ENTITY           — "1" (default) publishes to
 36                                               {base_topic}/{domain}/{entity_id};
 37                                               "0" sends all events to {base_topic}.
 38    """
 39
 40    def __init__(self, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
 41        kwargs.setdefault("name", "home-assistant-state-bridge")
 42        super().__init__(**kwargs)
 43        self.protected = False
 44
 45        self.ha_url = (os.getenv("HOME_ASSISTANT_URL") or CONFIG.ha_url or "").rstrip("/")
 46        self.ha_ws_url = normalize_ha_ws_url(self.ha_url)
 47        self.ha_token = (os.getenv("HOME_ASSISTANT_TOKEN") or CONFIG.ha_token or "").strip()
 48
 49        self._output_topic = (
 50            os.getenv("HA_STATE_BRIDGE_OUTPUT_TOPIC")
 51            or CONFIG.ha_state_bridge_output_topic
 52            or DEFAULT_OUTPUT_TOPIC
 53        ).strip()
 54
 55        _raw_domains = os.getenv("HA_STATE_BRIDGE_DOMAINS") or CONFIG.ha_state_bridge_domains or ""
 56        self._domain_filter: set[str] = _parse_domains(_raw_domains)
 57
 58        _per_entity_raw = os.getenv("HA_STATE_BRIDGE_PER_ENTITY")
 59        self._per_entity_topics: bool = (
 60            _per_entity_raw.strip() not in ("0", "false", "no")
 61            if _per_entity_raw is not None
 62            else CONFIG.ha_state_bridge_per_entity
 63        )
 64
 65        self._events_seen: int = 0
 66        self._last_event_at: float = 0.0
 67        self._last_error: str = ""
 68
 69    # ── Lifecycle ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 70
 71    async def on_start(self) -> None:
 72        self._events_seen = int(self.recall("events_seen", 0))
 73        self._last_event_at = float(self.recall("last_event_at", 0.0))
 74        self._last_error = str(self.recall("last_error", ""))
 75
 76        await self.publish_manifest(
 77            description="Bridges Home Assistant state_changed events to MQTT topics.",
 78            capabilities=["ha_state_bridge", "mqtt_publisher"],
 79            publishes=[self._output_topic],
 80            output_schema={
 81                "type": "str — always 'home_assistant_state_change'",
 82                "entity_id": "str — full entity ID (domain.name)",
 83                "domain": "str — entity domain (light, sensor, switch, …)",
 84                "new_state": "object — new HA state object",
 85                "old_state": "object|null — previous HA state object",
 86                "context": "object — HA event context",
 87                "timestamp": "float — unix epoch when the event was received",
 88            },
 89        )
 90        self._tasks.append(asyncio.create_task(self._state_change_listener()))
 91        logger.info(
 92            "[%s] started (domain_filter=%r, per_entity_topics=%s)",
 93            self.name,
 94            self._domain_filter,
 95            self._per_entity_topics,
 96        )
 97
 98    async def on_stop(self) -> None:
 99        self.persist("events_seen", self._events_seen)
100        self.persist("last_event_at", self._last_event_at)
101        self.persist("last_error", self._last_error)
102
103    # ── Message handling ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
104
105    def _spoken_status(self, status: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
106        """The status as a sentence, for a person rather than for a caller.
107
108        The chat surface prints `str(payload)` when a reply carries none of the
109        keys it knows to read, so without this the dict below reached people as
110        a Python repr.
111        """
112        if not status.get("configured"):
113            return (
114                "I forward Home Assistant state changes onto MQTT, but no instance "
115                "is configured, so I am not watching anything."
116            )
117        seen = status.get("events_seen", 0)
118        heard = f"{seen} state change{'' if seen == 1 else 's'} so far"
119        problem = status.get("last_error")
120        trouble = f" The last thing to go wrong: {problem}." if problem else ""
121        return (
122            f"I forward Home Assistant state changes onto {status.get('output_topic')}. "
123            f"I have seen {heard}.{trouble}"
124        )
125
126    async def handle_message(self, msg: Message) -> None:
127        if msg.type != MessageType.TASK:
128            return
129
130        command = self._extract_command(msg.payload)
131        if command == "status":
132            payload: dict[str, Any] = self._build_status_payload()
133            payload["result"] = self._spoken_status(payload)
134        else:
135            payload = {
136                "result": (
137                    "I cannot answer questions. I forward Home Assistant state changes "
138                    "onto MQTT, and the only thing I understand is 'status'."
139                ),
140                "error": "Unsupported command. Use 'status'.",
141                "supported_commands": ["status"],
142            }
143            self.metrics.tasks_failed += 1
144
145        if msg.sender_id:
146            await self.send(msg.sender_id, MessageType.RESULT, payload)
147
148    # ── HA WebSocket listener ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
149
150    async def _state_change_listener(self) -> None:
151        if not self.ha_url or not self.ha_ws_url or not self.ha_token:
152            self._last_error = (
153                "HA_URL/HOME_ASSISTANT_URL or HA_TOKEN/HOME_ASSISTANT_TOKEN is not configured"
154            )
155            logger.warning("[%s] %s", self.name, self._last_error)
156            return
157
158        while self.state not in (ActorState.STOPPED, ActorState.FAILED):
159            try:
160                async with HAWebSocketClient(self.ha_ws_url, self.ha_token) as ha:
161                    subscription_id = await ha.subscribe_events(STATE_CHANGED_EVENT)
162                    self._last_error = ""
163                    logger.info(
164                        "[%s] subscribed to Home Assistant '%s' events",
165                        self.name,
166                        STATE_CHANGED_EVENT,
167                    )
168
169                    while self.state not in (ActorState.STOPPED, ActorState.FAILED):
170                        event_message = await ha.receive_event(subscription_id)
171                        await self._handle_state_change(event_message)
172
173            except asyncio.CancelledError:
174                break
175            except Exception as exc:
176                self._last_error = str(exc)
177                logger.warning("[%s] listener error: %s", self.name, exc)
178                if self.state not in (ActorState.STOPPED, ActorState.FAILED):
179                    await asyncio.sleep(5)
180
181    async def _handle_state_change(self, event_message: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
182        event_data: dict[str, Any] = event_message.get("event", {}).get("data", {})
183        entity_id: str = event_data.get("entity_id", "")
184        domain: str = entity_id.split(".")[0] if "." in entity_id else ""
185
186        if self._domain_filter and domain not in self._domain_filter:
187            return
188
189        payload = self._build_state_change_payload(event_data, entity_id, domain)
190        topic = (
191            f"{self._output_topic}/{domain}/{entity_id}"
192            if self._per_entity_topics
193            else self._output_topic
194        )
195        await self._mqtt_publish(topic, payload)
196
197        self._events_seen += 1
198        self._last_event_at = payload["timestamp"]
199        self.metrics.tasks_completed += 1
200
201    # ── Payload builders ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
202
203    def _build_state_change_payload(
204        self, event_data: dict[str, Any], entity_id: str, domain: str
205    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
206        return {
207            "type": "home_assistant_state_change",
208            "entity_id": entity_id,
209            "domain": domain,
210            "new_state": event_data.get("new_state"),
211            "old_state": event_data.get("old_state"),
212            "context": event_data.get("context", {}),
213            "timestamp": time.time(),
214        }
215
216    def _build_status_payload(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
217        return {
218            "configured": bool(self.ha_url and self.ha_token),
219            "event_type": STATE_CHANGED_EVENT,
220            "events_seen": self._events_seen,
221            "last_event_at": self._last_event_at,
222            "last_error": self._last_error,
223            "output_topic": self._output_topic,
224            "domain_filter": sorted(self._domain_filter),
225            "per_entity_topics": self._per_entity_topics,
226        }
227
228    # ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
229
230    def _extract_command(self, payload: Any) -> str:
231        if isinstance(payload, dict):
232            text = payload.get("text") or payload.get("task") or payload.get("command") or ""
233        else:
234            text = payload
235        return str(text or "").strip().lower()
236
237    def _current_task_description(self) -> str:
238        if self._last_error:
239            return f"waiting for HA state changes (error: {self._last_error})"
240        domains = ", ".join(sorted(self._domain_filter)) if self._domain_filter else "all"
241        return f"watching {STATE_CHANGED_EVENT} domains={domains} ({self._events_seen} seen)"

Subscribes to Home Assistant state_changed events and publishes them to MQTT.

Configuration (environment variables): HA_URL / HOME_ASSISTANT_URL — Home Assistant base URL HA_TOKEN / HOME_ASSISTANT_TOKEN — Long-lived access token HA_STATE_BRIDGE_OUTPUT_TOPIC — Base MQTT topic (default: homeassistant/state_changes) HA_STATE_BRIDGE_DOMAINS — Comma-separated domain allow-list (e.g. "light,switch,sensor"). Empty = all domains. HA_STATE_BRIDGE_PER_ENTITY — "1" (default) publishes to {base_topic}/{domain}/{entity_id}; "0" sends all events to {base_topic}.
