class MonitorActor(wactorz.Actor): 
 40class MonitorActor(Actor):
 41    def __init__(
 42        self,
 43        check_interval: float = 15.0,
 44        heartbeat_timeout: float = 60.0,
 45        auto_restart: bool = False,  # kept for API compat, ignored
 46        **kwargs,
 47    ):
 48        kwargs.setdefault("name", "monitor")
 49        super().__init__(**kwargs)
 50        self.check_interval = check_interval
 51        self.heartbeat_timeout = heartbeat_timeout
 52        self.protected = True
 53
 54        self._last_seen: dict[str, float] = {}
 55        self._alert_state: dict[str, bool] = {}
 56
 57        # Error event registry: actor_id -> latest error event dict
 58        self._error_registry: dict[str, dict] = {}
 59        # Cooldown: actor_id -> last time we notified main
 60        self._last_notified: dict[str, float] = {}
 61
 62        # Cached Process object — cpu_percent(interval=None) tracks a delta
 63        # between consecutive calls on the SAME instance; creating a new one
 64        # each time always returns 0.0.
 65        self._proc = psutil.Process()
 66
 67    async def on_start(self):
 68        if self._registry:
 69            now = time.time()
 70            for actor in self._registry.all_actors():
 71                if actor.actor_id != self.actor_id:
 72                    self._last_seen[actor.actor_id] = now
 73
 74        # Prime the baseline on the cached instance so the first real reading
 75        # is meaningful (cpu_percent needs two samples on the same object).
 76        if self._proc is not None:
 77            # Declared Any | None on Actor, where psutil.Process() is built
 78            # inside a try — it can fail, and this agent reads it every cycle.
 79            try:
 80                self._proc.cpu_percent(interval=None)
 81            except Exception:
 82                pass
 83
 84        self._tasks.append(asyncio.create_task(self._monitor_loop()))
 85        logger.info(f"[{self.name}] Monitor started. check_interval={self.check_interval}s")
 86
 87    # ── Message handling ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
 88
 89    async def handle_message(self, msg: Message):
 90        # Any message from an actor counts as a liveness signal
 91        if msg.sender_id and msg.sender_id != self.actor_id:
 92            self._last_seen[msg.sender_id] = time.time()
 93            if self._alert_state.get(msg.sender_id):
 94                logger.info(f"[{self.name}] Actor {msg.sender_id[:8]} recovered.")
 95                self._alert_state[msg.sender_id] = False
 96
 97        # Structured error event forwarded from agents/{id}/errors
 98        if (
 99            msg.type == MessageType.TASK
100            and isinstance(msg.payload, dict)
101            and msg.payload.get("_monitor_error_event")
102        ):
103            await self._handle_error_event(msg.payload)
104
105    # ── Monitor loop ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
106
107    async def _monitor_loop(self):
108        while self.state not in (ActorState.STOPPED, ActorState.FAILED):
109            try:
110                await asyncio.sleep(self.check_interval)
111                await self._ping_all_actors()
112                await self._check_all_actors()
113                await self._check_error_registry()
114                self._forget_departed()
115                await self._publish_system_health()
116                await self._publish_host_stats()
117            except asyncio.CancelledError:
118                break
119            except Exception as e:
120                logger.error(f"[{self.name}] Monitor loop error: {e}")
121
122    async def _ping_all_actors(self):
123        if not self._registry:
124            return
125        for actor in self._registry.all_actors():
126            if actor.actor_id != self.actor_id:
127                try:
128                    await self.send(actor.actor_id, MessageType.STATUS_REQUEST, None)
129                except Exception:
130                    pass
131
132    async def _check_all_actors(self):
133        if not self._registry:
134            return
135        now = time.time()
136        for actor in self._registry.all_actors():
137            if actor.actor_id == self.actor_id:
138                continue
139            if actor.actor_id not in self._last_seen:
140                self._last_seen[actor.actor_id] = now
141                continue
142
143            # Use heartbeat timestamp as stronger liveness signal when available
144            if actor.state == ActorState.RUNNING:
145                start_age = now - (actor.metrics.start_time or now)
146                if start_age < self.heartbeat_timeout:
147                    self._last_seen[actor.actor_id] = max(
148                        self._last_seen[actor.actor_id], now - start_age
149                    )
150            hb = getattr(actor.metrics, "last_heartbeat", None)
151            if hb and hb > self._last_seen.get(actor.actor_id, 0):
152                self._last_seen[actor.actor_id] = hb
153
154            gap = now - self._last_seen[actor.actor_id]
155            if gap > self.heartbeat_timeout and actor.state == ActorState.RUNNING:
156                if not self._alert_state.get(actor.actor_id):
157                    self._alert_state[actor.actor_id] = True
158                    await self._fire_heartbeat_alert(actor, gap)
159                    # No restart here — Supervisor's heartbeat-silence detector
160                    # (HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT=35s) will catch this independently.
161            else:
162                if self._alert_state.get(actor.actor_id) and gap <= self.heartbeat_timeout:
163                    self._alert_state[actor.actor_id] = False
164
165    # ── Error event handling ───────────────────────────────────────────────
166
167    async def _handle_error_event(self, event: dict):
168        """Observer-only: classify severity, fire MQTT alert, notify user.
169        The Supervisor is the single restart authority — never call
170        actor.stop() / actor.start() here.
171        """
172        actor_id = event.get("actor_id", "")
173        name = event.get("name", actor_id[:8])
174        phase = event.get("phase", "unknown")
175        error = event.get("error", "")
176        severity = event.get("severity", "warning")
177        fatal = event.get("fatal", False)
178        degraded = event.get("degraded", False)
179        consec = event.get("consecutive", 1)
180
181        self._error_registry[actor_id] = event
182
183        logger.warning(
184            f"[{self.name}] Error event from '{name}': "
185            f"phase={phase} severity={severity} consecutive={consec}"
186        )
187
188        # Always fire low-level MQTT alert for dashboards
189        await self._fire_error_alert(event)
190
191        # ── Notify user (cooldown-gated) ───────────────────────────────────
192        if fatal:
193            msg = (
194                f"**{name}** failed during *{phase}* and cannot run: `{error}`. "
195                f"The Supervisor will retry if budget allows; otherwise the agent "
196                f"needs its code fixed."
197            )
198            await self._notify_main(actor_id, name, msg, severity="critical")
199
200        elif severity == "critical" or degraded:
201            msg = (
202                f"**{name}** is crashing in *{phase}* ({consec}x): `{error}`. "
203                f"The Supervisor is handling restarts automatically."
204            )
205            await self._notify_main(actor_id, name, msg, severity="critical")
206
207        # severity == "warning" -> just the MQTT alert, no user notification
208
209    def _forget_departed(self) -> None:
210        """Drop tracking for actors that are gone.
211
212        Every message counts as a liveness signal, so `_last_seen` takes an
213        entry for any sender — including ids that were never local actors. None
214        of these maps had a removal path, so they grew with agent churn and with
215        anything publishing under a fresh id.
216
217        An actor still in the registry is kept regardless of age; one that has
218        left is kept only while its last signal is recent, which is the window a
219        restart needs to re-register without losing its history.
220
221        `_error_registry` is swept here too. Its own cleanup only fires when a
222        live actor reports zero consecutive errors, so an agent that departs
223        while degraded is never cleared by it — recovery cannot arrive for an
224        actor that is gone. That entry also counts toward the `degraded` figure
225        in system health, so leaving it behind reports trouble in an agent that
226        no longer exists.
227        """
228        live = {a.actor_id for a in self._registry.all_actors()} if self._registry else set()
229        grace = time.time() - self.heartbeat_timeout * 2
230        keep = live | {aid for aid, seen in self._last_seen.items() if seen > grace}
231        for tracked in (
232            self._last_seen,
233            self._alert_state,
234            self._last_notified,
235            self._error_registry,
236        ):
237            for actor_id in [k for k in tracked if k not in keep]:
238                tracked.pop(actor_id, None)
239
240    async def _check_error_registry(self):
241        """Notify user when a previously degraded agent has recovered."""
242        for actor_id, event in list(self._error_registry.items()):
243            actor = self._find_actor(actor_id)
244            name = event.get("name", actor_id[:8])
245            if actor and hasattr(actor, "_consecutive_errors") and actor._consecutive_errors == 0:  # pyright: ignore[reportAttributeAccessIssue]
246                del self._error_registry[actor_id]
247                await self._notify_main(
248                    actor_id,
249                    name,
250                    f"**{name}** has recovered and is running normally again. ✅",
251                    severity="info",
252                )
253
254    # ── User notification ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
255
256    async def _notify_main(
257        self,
258        actor_id: str,
259        agent_name: str,
260        message: str,
261        severity: str = "warning",
262    ):
263        now = time.time()
264        cooldown = self._last_notified.get(actor_id, 0)
265        if (now - cooldown) < _NOTIFY_COOLDOWN and severity != "info":
266            return
267
268        self._last_notified[actor_id] = now
269
270        if not self._registry:
271            return
272        main = find_main_actor(self._registry)
273        if not main:
274            return
275
276        try:
277            await self.send(
278                main.actor_id,
279                MessageType.TASK,
280                {
281                    "_monitor_notification": True,
282                    "agent_name": agent_name,
283                    "message": message,
284                    "severity": severity,
285                    "timestamp": now,
286                },
287            )
288            logger.info(f"[{self.name}] Notified main about '{agent_name}': {message[:80]}")
289        except Exception as e:
290            logger.error(f"[{self.name}] Failed to notify main: {e}")
291
292    # ── Alerting ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
293
294    async def _fire_heartbeat_alert(self, actor: Actor, gap: float):
295        alert = {
296            "actor_id": actor.actor_id,
297            "name": actor.name,
298            "last_seen_ago": gap,
299            "state": actor.state.value,
300            "timestamp": time.time(),
301            "severity": "warning" if gap < 120 else "critical",
302        }
303        logger.warning(f"[{self.name}] ALERT: {actor.name} unresponsive for {gap:.0f}s")
304        await self._mqtt_publish(f"agents/{actor.actor_id}/alert", alert)
305
306        _infra = {
307            "monitor",
308            "installer",
309            "main",
310            "code-agent",
311            "anomaly-detector",
312            "home-assistant-agent",
313        }
314        if actor.name not in _infra:
315            await self._notify_main(
316                actor.actor_id,
317                actor.name,
318                f"**{actor.name}** has been unresponsive for {gap:.0f}s — "
319                f"the Supervisor will restart it if it stays silent.",
320                severity="warning",
321            )
322
323    async def _fire_error_alert(self, event: dict):
324        await self._mqtt_publish(
325            f"agents/{event.get('actor_id', 'unknown')}/alert",
326            {
327                "actor_id": event.get("actor_id"),
328                "name": event.get("name"),
329                "message": f"[{event.get('phase')}] {event.get('error')}",
330                "severity": event.get("severity", "warning"),
331                "timestamp": time.time(),
332            },
333        )
334
335    # ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
336
337    def _find_actor(self, actor_id: str) -> Actor | None:
338        if not self._registry:
339            return None
340        for a in self._registry.all_actors():
341            if a.actor_id == actor_id:
342                return a
343        return None
344
345    async def _publish_system_health(self):
346        if not self._registry:
347            return
348        now = time.time()
349        actors = self._registry.all_actors()
350        health = {
351            "timestamp": now,
352            "total_actors": len(actors),
353            "running": sum(1 for a in actors if a.state == ActorState.RUNNING),
354            "stopped": sum(1 for a in actors if a.state == ActorState.STOPPED),
355            "failed": sum(1 for a in actors if a.state == ActorState.FAILED),
356            "degraded": len(self._error_registry),
357            "actors": [
358                {
359                    "id": a.actor_id,
360                    "name": a.name,
361                    "state": a.state.value,
362                    "last_seen_ago": now - self._last_seen.get(a.actor_id, now),
363                    "consecutive_errors": getattr(a, "_consecutive_errors", 0),
364                    "error_phase": getattr(a, "_error_phase", ""),
365                }
366                for a in actors
367            ],
368        }
369        await self._mqtt_publish("system/health", health)
370
371    async def _publish_host_stats(self):
372        proc = self._proc
373        if proc is None:
374            # No process handle means no host stats; the rest of the monitor's
375            # reporting is unaffected, so this is a skip rather than a failure.
376            return
377        try:
378            cpu_pct = proc.cpu_percent(interval=None)
379            mem_info = proc.memory_info()
380            mem_used_mb = mem_info.rss / 1024 / 1024
381            mem_total_mb = psutil.virtual_memory().total / 1024 / 1024
382            stats = {
383                "cpu": cpu_pct,
384                "mem_used_mb": mem_used_mb,
385                "mem_total_mb": mem_total_mb,
386                "timestamp": time.time(),
387            }
388            await self._mqtt_publish("system/host", stats)
389        except Exception as e:
390            logger.debug(f"[{self.name}] host stats error: {e}")

82                pass
83
84        self._tasks.append(asyncio.create_task(self._monitor_loop()))
85        logger.info(f"[{self.name}] Monitor started. check_interval={self.check_interval}s")

Called when actor starts. Override for init logic.

async def handle_message(self, msg: Message): 
 89    async def handle_message(self, msg: Message):
 90        # Any message from an actor counts as a liveness signal
 91        if msg.sender_id and msg.sender_id != self.actor_id:
 92            self._last_seen[msg.sender_id] = time.time()
 93            if self._alert_state.get(msg.sender_id):
 94                logger.info(f"[{self.name}] Actor {msg.sender_id[:8]} recovered.")
 95                self._alert_state[msg.sender_id] = False
 96
 97        # Structured error event forwarded from agents/{id}/errors
 98        if (
 99            msg.type == MessageType.TASK
100            and isinstance(msg.payload, dict)
101            and msg.payload.get("_monitor_error_event")
102        ):
103            await self._handle_error_event(msg.payload)

class NIMProvider(wactorz.agents.llm.base.LLMProvider): 
 27class NIMProvider(LLMProvider):
 28    """NVIDIA NIM — OpenAI-compatible API hosted at integrate.api.nvidia.com.
 29    Free tier: 1000 requests/month per model. No local GPU required.
 30
 31    Popular free models:
 32      meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct          — fast, lightweight
 33      meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct         — strong general purpose
 34      mistralai/mistral-7b-instruct-v0.3  — fast & capable
 35      mistralai/mixtral-8x7b-instruct-v0.1
 36      google/gemma-3-27b-it
 37      microsoft/phi-3-mini-128k-instruct
 38      deepseek-ai/deepseek-r1             — reasoning model
 39      deepseek-ai/deepseek-r1-distill-qwen-7b
 40      nvidia/llama-3.1-nemotron-70b-instruct
 41      nvidia/llama-3.3-nemotron-super-49b-v1
 42
 43    Get a free API key at: https://build.nvidia.com
 44    """
 45
 46    NIM_BASE_URL = "https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1"
 47
 48    def __init__(
 49        self,
 50        model: str = "meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct",
 51        api_key: str | None = None,
 52        base_url: str = NIM_BASE_URL,
 53    ):
 54        import openai
 55
 56        self.model = model
 57        self.base_url = base_url
 58        self.client = openai.AsyncOpenAI(
 59            api_key=api_key or "dummy",  # NIM free tier may not require a key locally
 60            base_url=base_url,
 61        )
 62
 63    @classmethod
 64    def supports_blocks(cls) -> bool:
 65        """Block content is translated to this format's parts on the way out
 66        (see ``openai_shape.openai_content``), so a list content is safe here.
 67        """
 68        return True
 69
 70    async def _create_completion(self, params: dict[str, Any]):
 71        """Create a completion, retrying without reasoning knobs if rejected.
 72
 73        Some NIM models don't accept the ``enable_thinking`` chat-template flag
 74        or ``reasoning_effort``; rather than fail the whole turn, drop those
 75        knobs and retry once so non-reasoning models keep working.
 76        """
 77        try:
 78            return await self.client.chat.completions.create(**params)
 79        except Exception as exc:
 80            msg = str(exc).lower()
 81            retryable = any(
 82                token in msg
 83                for token in ("reasoning", "enable_thinking", "chat_template", "extra_body")
 84            )
 85            if retryable and ("extra_body" in params or "reasoning_effort" in params):
 86                params.pop("extra_body", None)
 87                params.pop("reasoning_effort", None)
 88                return await self.client.chat.completions.create(**params)
 89            raise
 90
 91    async def _complete(self, messages: list[dict], system: str = "", **kwargs) -> tuple[str, dict]:
 92        full_messages = (
 93            [{"role": "system", "content": system}] if system else []
 94        ) + openai_messages(messages)
 95        params: dict[str, Any] = {
 96            "model": self.model,
 97            "messages": full_messages,
 98            "max_tokens": kwargs.get("max_tokens", 8192),
 99            **_temp_params(kwargs),
100        }
101        _apply_openai_reasoning(params, self.model, kwargs.get("reasoning_effort"))
102        response = await self._create_completion(params)
103        text = _content_or_reasoning(response.choices[0].message)
104        input_tok = response.usage.prompt_tokens if response.usage else 0
105        output_tok = response.usage.completion_tokens if response.usage else 0
106        usage = {
107            "input_tokens": input_tok,
108            "output_tokens": output_tok,
109            "cost_usd": calc_cost(self.model, input_tok, output_tok),
110        }
111        return text, usage
112
113    async def _complete_with_tools(
114        self,
115        messages: list[dict],
116        tools: list[dict[str, Any]],
117        system: str = "",
118        **kwargs: Any,
119    ) -> ToolCompletion:
120        full_messages = (
121            [{"role": "system", "content": system}] if system else []
122        ) + openai_messages(
123            [_openai_tool_result_message(m) if m.get("role") == "tool" else m for m in messages]
124        )
125        try:
126            response = await self.client.chat.completions.create(
127                model=self.model,
128                messages=cast("list[ChatCompletionMessageParam]", full_messages),
129                tools=cast("list[ChatCompletionToolUnionParam]", _openai_tools(tools)),
130                tool_choice=kwargs.get("tool_choice", "auto"),
131                max_tokens=kwargs.get("max_tokens", 8192),
132                **_temp_params(kwargs),
133            )
134        except Exception as exc:
135            raise RuntimeError(
136                f"NIM tool calling failed; verify the selected model supports tools: {exc}"
137            ) from exc
138        message = response.choices[0].message
139        raw_calls = getattr(message, "tool_calls", None) or []
140        tool_calls = [
141            ToolCall(
142                id=getattr(call, "id", ""),
143                name=getattr(getattr(call, "function", None), "name", ""),
144                arguments=_parse_tool_arguments(
145                    getattr(getattr(call, "function", None), "arguments", "{}")
146                ),
147            )
148            for call in raw_calls
149        ]
150        assistant_message = {
151            "role": "assistant",
152            "content": getattr(message, "content", None),
153        }
154        if raw_calls:
155            assistant_message["tool_calls"] = [
156                {
157                    "id": getattr(call, "id", ""),
158                    "type": "function",
159                    "function": {
160                        "name": getattr(getattr(call, "function", None), "name", ""),
161                        "arguments": getattr(getattr(call, "function", None), "arguments", "{}"),
162                    },
163                }
164                for call in raw_calls
165            ]
166        return ToolCompletion(
167            content=getattr(message, "content", None) or "",
168            usage=_usage_from_openai(self.model, getattr(response, "usage", None)),
169            tool_calls=tool_calls,
170            assistant_message=assistant_message,
171        )
172
173    async def _stream(self, messages: list[dict], system: str = "", **kwargs):
174        """Yield text chunks as they arrive. Final item is a dict with usage."""
175        full_messages = (
176            [{"role": "system", "content": system}] if system else []
177        ) + openai_messages(messages)
178        input_tokens = output_tokens = 0
179        params: dict[str, Any] = {
180            "model": self.model,
181            "messages": full_messages,
182            "max_tokens": kwargs.get("max_tokens", 8192),
183            "stream": True,
184            **_temp_params(kwargs),
185        }
186        _apply_openai_reasoning(params, self.model, kwargs.get("reasoning_effort"))
187        stream_cm = await self._create_completion(params)
188        async with stream_cm as s:
189            async for chunk in s:
190                if not chunk.choices:
191                    if chunk.usage:
192                        input_tokens = chunk.usage.prompt_tokens
193                        output_tokens = chunk.usage.completion_tokens
194                    continue
195                delta = chunk.choices[0].delta.content
196                if not delta:
197                    # Reasoning models stream chain-of-thought on a separate
198                    # field; surface it so a thinking response isn't silent.
199                    delta = getattr(chunk.choices[0].delta, "reasoning_content", None)
200                if delta:
201                    yield delta
202                if chunk.usage:
203                    input_tokens = chunk.usage.prompt_tokens
204                    output_tokens = chunk.usage.completion_tokens
205        yield {
206            "input_tokens": input_tokens,
207            "output_tokens": output_tokens,
208            "cost_usd": calc_cost(self.model, input_tokens, output_tokens),
209        }

class OllamaProvider(wactorz.agents.llm.base.LLMProvider): 
 21class OllamaProvider(LLMProvider):
 22    """Local LLM via Ollama."""
 23
 24    def __init__(self, model: str = "llama3", base_url: str = "http://localhost:11434"):
 25        self.model = model
 26        self.base_url = base_url
 27
 28    @classmethod
 29    def supports_blocks(cls) -> bool:
 30        """Block content is translated on the way out (images to the
 31        message-level ``images`` field) in ``_chat_messages``, so a list
 32        content is safe here. Whether the *model* does anything with an image
 33        is its own question — a non-vision model ignores the field.
 34        """
 35        return True
 36
 37    @staticmethod
 38    def _chat_messages(messages: list[dict], system: str = "") -> list[dict]:
 39        out: list[dict] = []
 40        for m in messages:
 41            content = m.get("content") if isinstance(m, dict) else m
 42            if isinstance(content, list):
 43                # Blocks → this format: text joins into content, images go to
 44                # the message-level `images` field (the only place /api/chat
 45                # takes them), documents become a marker — there is no inline
 46                # document part, and the name note to_blocks emits already says
 47                # what the file was called.
 48                text_parts: list[str] = []
 49                images: list[str] = []
 50                for block in content:
 51                    if not isinstance(block, dict):
 52                        text_parts.append(str(block))
 53                        continue
 54                    block_type = block.get("type")
 55                    if block_type == "text":
 56                        text_parts.append(str(block.get("text", "")))
 57                    elif block_type == "image":
 58                        data = (block.get("source") or {}).get("data") or ""
 59                        if data:
 60                            images.append(data)
 61                        else:
 62                            text_parts.append(UNREADABLE)
 63                    elif block_type == "document":
 64                        text_parts.append(NO_DOCUMENTS)
 65                    else:
 66                        # Not an attachment block. Content here is a flat
 67                        # string, so there is nowhere to pass one through to.
 68                        text_parts.append(str(block))
 69                m = {**m, "content": "\n".join(p for p in text_parts if p)}
 70                if images:
 71                    m["images"] = images
 72            out.append(m)
 73        if not system:
 74            return out
 75        return [{"role": "system", "content": system}, *out]
 76
 77    async def _complete(self, messages: list[dict], system: str = "", **kwargs) -> tuple[str, dict]:
 78        payload = {
 79            "model": self.model,
 80            "messages": self._chat_messages(messages, system),
 81            "stream": False,
 82            **_ollama_options(kwargs),
 83        }
 84        async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
 85            async with session.post(
 86                f"{self.base_url}/api/chat", json=payload, timeout=_OLLAMA_TIMEOUT
 87            ) as resp:
 88                resp.raise_for_status()
 89                data = await resp.json()
 90        text = (data.get("message") or {}).get("content") or ""
 91        prompt_eval = data.get("prompt_eval_count", 0)
 92        eval_count = data.get("eval_count", 0)
 93        usage = {"input_tokens": prompt_eval, "output_tokens": eval_count, "cost_usd": 0.0}
 94        return text, usage
 95
 96    async def _complete_with_tools(
 97        self,
 98        messages: list[dict],
 99        tools: list[dict[str, Any]],
100        system: str = "",
101        **kwargs: Any,
102    ) -> ToolCompletion:
103        ollama_messages = []
104        for message in messages:
105            if message.get("role") == "tool":
106                ollama_messages.append(
107                    {
108                        "role": "tool",
109                        "content": str(message.get("content", "")),
110                        "tool_name": message.get("name") or message.get("tool_name") or "",
111                    }
112                )
113            else:
114                ollama_messages.append(message)
115        payload = {
116            "model": self.model,
117            "messages": self._chat_messages(ollama_messages, system),
118            "stream": False,
119            "tools": _openai_tools(tools),
120            **_ollama_options(kwargs),
121        }
122        async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
123            async with session.post(
124                f"{self.base_url}/api/chat", json=payload, timeout=_OLLAMA_TIMEOUT
125            ) as resp:
126                resp.raise_for_status()
127                data = await resp.json()
128
129        message = data.get("message") or {}
130        raw_calls = message.get("tool_calls") or []
131        tool_calls: list[ToolCall] = []
132        for idx, call in enumerate(raw_calls):
133            function = call.get("function", {}) if isinstance(call, dict) else {}
134            tool_calls.append(
135                ToolCall(
136                    id=str(call.get("id") or f"ollama_tool_{idx}")
137                    if isinstance(call, dict)
138                    else f"ollama_tool_{idx}",
139                    name=str(function.get("name") or ""),
140                    arguments=_parse_tool_arguments(function.get("arguments") or {}),
141                )
142            )
143        usage = {
144            "input_tokens": data.get("prompt_eval_count", 0),
145            "output_tokens": data.get("eval_count", 0),
146            "cost_usd": 0.0,
147        }
148        assistant_message = {
149            "role": "assistant",
150            "content": message.get("content", ""),
151        }
152        if raw_calls:
153            assistant_message["tool_calls"] = raw_calls
154        return ToolCompletion(
155            content=message.get("content", "") or "",
156            usage=usage,
157            tool_calls=tool_calls,
158            assistant_message=assistant_message,
159        )
160
161    async def _stream(self, messages: list[dict], system: str = "", **kwargs):
162        """Yield text chunks as they arrive. Final item is a dict with usage."""
163        payload = {
164            "model": self.model,
165            "messages": self._chat_messages(messages, system),
166            "stream": True,
167            **_ollama_options(kwargs),
168        }
169        input_tokens = output_tokens = 0
170        async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
171            async with session.post(
172                f"{self.base_url}/api/chat", json=payload, timeout=_OLLAMA_STREAM_TIMEOUT
173            ) as resp:
174                resp.raise_for_status()
175                async for raw in resp.content:
176                    if not raw.strip():
177                        continue
178                    try:
179                        data = json.loads(raw)
180                    except Exception:
181                        continue
182                    delta = (data.get("message") or {}).get("content", "")
183                    if delta:
184                        yield delta
185                    if data.get("done"):
186                        input_tokens = data.get("prompt_eval_count", 0)
187                        output_tokens = data.get("eval_count", 0)
188        yield {"input_tokens": input_tokens, "output_tokens": output_tokens, "cost_usd": 0.0}

class OneOffActuatorAgent(wactorz.Actor): 
 377class OneOffActuatorAgent(Actor):
 378    """Ephemeral actor that resolves and executes one-shot HA service calls."""
 379
 380    DESCRIPTION = "Ephemeral Home Assistant actuator for one-shot natural-language device control"
 381    CAPABILITIES: ClassVar[list[str]] = [
 382        "home_automation",
 383        "ha_actuation",
 384        "device_control",
 385        "one_shot_actuation",
 386    ]
 387
 388    def __init__(
 389        self,
 390        request: str,
 391        llm_provider: LLMProvider | None,
 392        task_id: str,
 393        reply_to_id: str,
 394        conversation_context: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
 395        allowed_domains: frozenset[str] | set[str] | None = None,
 396        **kwargs: Any,
 397    ) -> None:
 398        kwargs.setdefault("name", f"one-off-actuator-{task_id[-8:]}")
 399        super().__init__(**kwargs)
 400        self.request = request
 401        self.conversation_context = list(conversation_context or [])[-4:]
 402        self.llm = llm_provider
 403        self.task_id = task_id
 404        self.reply_to_id = reply_to_id
 405        # None = trusted caller (dashboard/CLI), every domain allowed. A set
 406        # restricts execution to those domains; see SOCIAL_ACTUATE_DOMAINS.
 407        self.allowed_domains = frozenset(allowed_domains) if allowed_domains is not None else None
 408        self.total_input_tokens = 0
 409        self.total_output_tokens = 0
 410        self.total_cost_usd = 0.0
 411        self._last_period_cost_usd = 0.0
 412
 413    def _current_task_description(self) -> str:
 414        return self.request[:60] if self.request else "one-shot actuation"
 415
 416    async def on_start(self) -> None:
 417        await self.publish_manifest(
 418            description=self.DESCRIPTION,
 419            capabilities=self.CAPABILITIES,
 420            input_schema={
 421                "request": "str — natural-language Home Assistant device control request",
 422                "task_id": "str — correlation id for the parent future",
 423                "reply_to_id": "str — actor id that should receive the RESULT message",
 424            },
 425            output_schema={
 426                "result": "str — human-readable summary of executed Home Assistant service calls",
 427                "_task_id": "str — correlation id echoed back to the parent actor",
 428            },
 429        )
 430        asyncio.create_task(self._run())
 431
 432    async def handle_message(self, msg: Message):
 433        if msg.type == MessageType.TASK:
 434            return
 435
 436    async def _run(self) -> None:
 437        try:
 438            result = await self._execute_request()
 439            self.metrics.tasks_completed += 1
 440            await self._mqtt_publish(
 441                f"agents/{self.actor_id}/metrics",
 442                self._build_metrics(),
 443            )
 444            await self._send_result(result)
 445        except Exception as exc:
 446            self.metrics.tasks_failed += 1
 447            await self._mqtt_publish(
 448                f"agents/{self.actor_id}/metrics",
 449                self._build_metrics(),
 450            )
 451            logger.error("[%s] One-shot actuation failed: %s", self.name, exc, exc_info=True)
 452            await self._send_result(f"Actuation failed: {exc}")
 453        finally:
 454            asyncio.create_task(self._deferred_stop())
 455
 456    async def _execute_request(self) -> str:
 457        if not CONFIG.ha_url or not CONFIG.ha_token:
 458            return (
 459                "Home Assistant is not configured. Set `HA_URL` and `HA_TOKEN` in your .env file."
 460            )
 461        if self.llm is None:
 462            return "Actuation failed: no LLM provider is available."
 463
 464        devices = await fetch_devices_entities_with_location(
 465            CONFIG.ha_url,
 466            CONFIG.ha_token,
 467            include_states=True,
 468        )
 469        actions = await self._resolve_actions(devices)
 470        if not actions:
 471            return "I couldn't identify a matching device for that request."
 472
 473        return await self._execute_actions(actions)
 474
 475    async def _resolve_actions(self, devices: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[ActuatorAction]:
 476        common = self._resolve_simple_light_actions(devices)
 477        if common is not None:
 478            return common
 479        # Send the model only the fields it can act on. The dashboard payload is
 480        # ~3x larger, and the bulk of it (unique_id, platform, icons, feature
 481        # bitmasks) is never mentioned by the resolver prompt. Post-processing
 482        # below still reads the FULL payload, so colour repair keeps working.
 483        prompt_input = {
 484            "user_request": self.request,
 485            "conversation_context": self.conversation_context,
 486            "devices": compact_devices_for_prompt(devices),
 487        }
 488        llm = self.llm
 489        if llm is None:
 490            # _execute_request checks before calling, but that guard does not
 491            # carry into here; no provider means no actions to take.
 492            return []
 493        raw, usage = await asyncio.wait_for(
 494            llm.complete(
 495                messages=[{"role": "user", "content": json.dumps(prompt_input)}],
 496                system=_RESOLVER_PROMPT,
 497                max_tokens=1200,
 498            ),
 499            timeout=120.0,
 500        )
 501        self._accumulate_usage(usage)
 502        try:
 503            parsed = self._parse_actions_json(raw)
 504        except json.JSONDecodeError:
 505            # Output with no array in it at all. Letting this propagate would
 506            # surface a raw JSONDecodeError as the reply, which the voice path
 507            # then reads aloud; a no-match is the same outcome said properly.
 508            # Logged rather than swallowed so the bad output is still traceable.
 509            logger.warning(
 510                "[%s] Actuator resolver returned unparseable output: %r", self.name, raw[:200]
 511            )
 512            return []
 513        actions = [ActuatorAction.from_dict(item) for item in parsed]
 514        actions = self._repair_color_actions(actions, devices)
 515        kept, dropped = filter_unrequested_actions(self.request, actions, devices)
 516        # Always log the verdict — an actuation with no "Guard:" line means the
 517        # running process is not executing this module.
 518        await self._log(
 519            f"Guard: resolver returned {len(actions)} action(s), "
 520            f"kept {len(kept)}, dropped {len(dropped)}"
 521            + (
 522                " — dropped: " + ", ".join(self._format_action(a) for a in dropped)
 523                if dropped
 524                else ""
 525            )
 526        )
 527        return kept
 528
 529    def _parse_actions_json(self, raw: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
 530        cleaned = (raw or "").strip()
 531        if not cleaned:
 532            return []
 533        if cleaned.startswith("```"):
 534            cleaned = cleaned.strip("`")
 535            cleaned = cleaned.removeprefix("json")
 536            cleaned = cleaned.strip()
 537        try:
 538            data = json.loads(cleaned)
 539        except json.JSONDecodeError:
 540            # Models occasionally wrap the array in prose despite the
 541            # JSON-only instruction. Salvage the first [...] span rather than
 542            # failing the whole actuation.
 543            start, end = cleaned.find("["), cleaned.rfind("]")
 544            if start == -1 or end <= start:
 545                raise
 546            data = json.loads(cleaned[start : end + 1])
 547        if not isinstance(data, list):
 548            return []
 549        return [item for item in data if isinstance(item, dict)]
 550
 551    def _clean_request(self) -> str:
 552        """The user's own words, lowercased, with any injected entity-context
 553        block stripped.
 554
 555        Main enriches the request with an ``[AVAILABLE HA ENTITIES ...]`` list
 556        before spawning this agent. The keyword heuristics below (colour,
 557        brightness, plurality) must read the user's actual phrasing, not entity
 558        names in that block — otherwise a ``Living Room Lights`` entity makes a
 559        singular "turn the light red" look plural, or a ``Red Lamp`` entity
 560        looks like a colour request.
 561        """
 562        text = self.request or ""
 563        idx = text.find("\n\n[AVAILABLE HA ENTITIES")
 564        if idx != -1:
 565            text = text[:idx]
 566        text = re.sub(r"\bman light\b", "main light", text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
 567        return text.lower()
 568
 569    def _resolve_simple_light_actions(
 570        self,
 571        devices: list[dict[str, Any]],
 572    ) -> list[ActuatorAction] | None:
 573        """Resolve ordinary light commands without relying on generated JSON."""
 574        request = self._clean_request()
 575        brightness_step = self._requested_brightness_step_pct()
 576        brightness_request = brightness_step is not None or "brightness" in request
 577        normal_request = self._requests_normal_light()
 578        if not re.search(r"\blights?\b", request) and not brightness_request:
 579            return None
 580
 581        rgb = [255, 255, 255] if normal_request else self._requested_rgb()
 582        if re.search(r"\b(turn|then|switch|shut)\s+off\b", request):
 583            service = "turn_off"
 584        elif (
 585            re.search(r"\b(turn|then|switch)\s+on\b", request)
 586            or rgb is not None
 587            or brightness_request
 588            or normal_request
 589        ):
 590            service = "turn_on"
 591        else:
 592            return None
 593
 594        lights = list(self._iter_entities(devices))
 595        if not lights:
 596            return None
 597
 598        if self._request_targets_multiple_lights():
 599            entity_ids = [str(entity.get("entity_id") or "") for entity in lights]
 600        else:
 601            entity_id = (
 602                self._find_color_light(devices)
 603                if rgb is not None and not normal_request
 604                else self._find_requested_light(lights, request)
 605            )
 606            if not entity_id:
 607                return None
 608            entity_ids = [entity_id]
 609
 610        service_data = {}
 611        if rgb is not None and service == "turn_on":
 612            service_data["rgb_color"] = rgb
 613        if brightness_step is not None and service == "turn_on":
 614            service_data["brightness_step_pct"] = brightness_step
 615        elif (self._requests_max_brightness() and service == "turn_on") or (
 616            normal_request and service == "turn_on"
 617        ):
 618            service_data["brightness_pct"] = 100
 619        return [
 620            ActuatorAction(
 621                domain="light",
 622                service=service,
 623                entity_id=entity_id,
 624                service_data=dict(service_data),
 625            )
 626            for entity_id in dict.fromkeys(entity_ids)
 627            if entity_id
 628        ]
 629
 630    def _find_requested_light(
 631        self,
 632        lights: list[dict[str, Any]],
 633        request: str,
 634    ) -> str | None:
 635        """Choose one explicitly named light, or the primary light if generic."""
 636        ignored = {
 637            "turn",
 638            "switch",
 639            "shut",
 640            "make",
 641            "set",
 642            "please",
 643            "light",
 644            "lights",
 645            "the",
 646            "my",
 647            "our",
 648            "your",
 649            "this",
 650            "that",
 651            "on",
 652            "off",
 653            "and",
 654            "can",
 655            "could",
 656            "would",
 657            "will",
 658            "you",
 659            "brightness",
 660            "bright",
 661            "brighter",
 662            "dim",
 663            "dimmer",
 664            "lower",
 665            "raise",
 666            "increase",
 667            "decrease",
 668            "reduce",
 669            "down",
 670            "up",
 671            "little",
 672            "slightly",
 673            "bit",
 674            "some",
 675            *list(_COLOR_RGB),
 676            "normal",
 677            "regular",
 678            "default",
 679        }
 680        specific = {
 681            token
 682            for token in re.findall(r"[a-z0-9]+", request)
 683            if len(token) > 2 and token not in ignored
 684        }
 685        recent_entity = self._recent_context_light(lights) if not specific else None
 686        if recent_entity:
 687            return recent_entity
 688
 689        ranked: list[tuple[int, int, str]] = []
 690        for entity in lights:
 691            entity_id = str(entity.get("entity_id") or "")
 692            attrs = self._entity_attrs(entity)
 693            haystack = " ".join(
 694                str(value).lower().replace("_", " ")
 695                for value in (
 696                    entity_id,
 697                    entity.get("name"),
 698                    entity.get("friendly_name"),
 699                    attrs.get("friendly_name"),
 700                    entity.get("area"),
 701                    entity.get("location"),
 702                )
 703                if value
 704            )
 705            score = sum(1 for token in specific if token in haystack)
 706            ranked.append((score, self._primary_light_preference(haystack), entity_id))
 707        ranked.sort(key=lambda item: (item[0], item[1], item[2]), reverse=True)
 708        if not ranked or (specific and ranked[0][0] == 0):
 709            return None
 710        return ranked[0][2]
 711
 712    def _requested_rgb(self) -> list[int] | None:
 713        text = self._clean_request()
 714        for color, rgb in _COLOR_RGB.items():
 715            # Whole-word match only: "infrared" must not count as "red",
 716            # "bluetooth" must not count as "blue".
 717            if re.search(rf"\b{color}\b", text):
 718                return list(rgb)
 719        return None
 720
 721    def _requests_max_brightness(self) -> bool:
 722        request = self._clean_request()
 723        explicit = any(
 724            phrase in request
 725            for phrase in (
 726                "max brightness",
 727                "maximum brightness",
 728                "full brightness",
 729                "brightest",
 730                "100% brightness",
 731                "100 percent brightness",
 732            )
 733        )
 734        return explicit or bool(re.search(r"\b(bright|brighter|brightly)\b", request))
 735
 736    def _requests_normal_light(self) -> bool:
 737        """Return whether the user wants a neutral, fully lit default state."""
 738        request = self._clean_request()
 739        return bool(
 740            re.search(
 741                r"\b(?:(?:normal|regular|default)(?:\s+(?:white\s+)?)?light|"
 742                r"light\s+(?:normal|regular|default))\b",
 743                request,
 744            )
 745        )
 746
 747    def _requested_brightness_step_pct(self) -> int | None:
 748        """Return a conservative relative brightness change, when requested."""
 749        request = self._clean_request()
 750        down = bool(re.search(r"\b(dim|dimmer|lower|decrease|reduce|turn\s+down)\b", request))
 751        up = bool(re.search(r"\b(brighter|raise|increase|turn\s+up)\b", request))
 752        if down == up:
 753            return None
 754        small = bool(re.search(r"\b(a\s+little|little\s+bit|a\s+bit|slightly)\b", request))
 755        amount = 15 if small else 25
 756        return -amount if down else amount
 757
 758    def _recent_context_light(self, lights: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> str | None:
 759        """Resolve generic follow-ups to the most recently controlled light."""
 760        available = {
 761            str(entity.get("entity_id") or "") for entity in lights if entity.get("entity_id")
 762        }
 763        for item in reversed(self.conversation_context):
 764            if not isinstance(item, dict):
 765                continue
 766            context = " ".join(
 767                str(item.get(key) or "") for key in ("response", "raw_response", "transcript")
 768            )
 769            matches = re.findall(r"\blight\.[a-z0-9_]+\b", context.lower())
 770            for entity_id in reversed(matches):
 771                if entity_id in available:
 772                    return entity_id
 773        return None
 774
 775    def _repair_color_actions(
 776        self,
 777        actions: list[ActuatorAction],
 778        devices: list[dict[str, Any]],
 779    ) -> list[ActuatorAction]:
 780        rgb = self._requested_rgb()
 781        if rgb is None:
 782            return actions
 783
 784        color_entity = self._find_color_light(devices)
 785        repaired: list[ActuatorAction] = []
 786        has_light_action = False
 787        for action in actions:
 788            if action.domain == "light" and action.service == "turn_on":
 789                has_light_action = True
 790                if color_entity and not self._entity_id_supports_color(action.entity_id, devices):
 791                    action.entity_id = color_entity
 792                action.service_data = dict(action.service_data or {})
 793                if not any(key in action.service_data for key in _COLOR_SERVICE_KEYS):
 794                    action.service_data["rgb_color"] = rgb
 795                if self._requests_max_brightness() and "brightness_pct" not in action.service_data:
 796                    action.service_data["brightness_pct"] = 100
 797            repaired.append(action)
 798
 799        if not has_light_action and color_entity:
 800            service_data: dict[str, Any] = {"rgb_color": rgb}
 801            if self._requests_max_brightness():
 802                service_data["brightness_pct"] = 100
 803            repaired.append(
 804                ActuatorAction(
 805                    domain="light",
 806                    service="turn_on",
 807                    entity_id=color_entity,
 808                    service_data=service_data,
 809                )
 810            )
 811        return self._collapse_generic_color_lights(repaired, color_entity)
 812
 813    def _request_targets_multiple_lights(self) -> bool:
 814        r"""True when the user clearly means more than one light, so a generic
 815        single-light collapse must NOT apply.
 816
 817        Scope/plural words ("all", "every", "each", "both", plural "lights"/
 818        "lamps") mean keep them all; a singular "the light" / "my lamp" is
 819        False. ``\\b`` boundaries keep "hallway" from matching "all".
 820        """
 821        return bool(re.search(r"\b(all|every|each|both|lights|lamps)\b", self._clean_request()))
 822
 823    def _collapse_generic_color_lights(
 824        self,
 825        actions: list[ActuatorAction],
 826        preferred_entity: str | None,
 827    ) -> list[ActuatorAction]:
 828        """Collapse a generic colour request that fanned out across several
 829        colour lights down to the single best one.
 830
 831        The resolver is handed every entity, so "change the light colour" in a
 832        home with two colour-capable lights can come back as a ``turn_on`` for
 833        BOTH — lighting the whole room instead of the one light the user meant.
 834        When the request names no specific light and isn't explicitly plural
 835        ("all/every/both lights"), keep only the best colour light (the one the
 836        colour repair already prefers) and drop the rest. Non-light actions and
 837        explicitly-plural requests pass through untouched.
 838        """
 839        if self._request_targets_multiple_lights():
 840            return actions
 841        light_ons = [a for a in actions if a.domain == "light" and a.service == "turn_on"]
 842        distinct = {a.entity_id for a in light_ons}
 843        if len(distinct) <= 1:
 844            return actions
 845        keep_id = preferred_entity if preferred_entity in distinct else min(distinct)
 846        collapsed: list[ActuatorAction] = []
 847        kept = False
 848        for action in actions:
 849            if action.domain == "light" and action.service == "turn_on":
 850                if action.entity_id == keep_id and not kept:
 851                    collapsed.append(action)
 852                    kept = True
 853                continue
 854            collapsed.append(action)
 855        return collapsed
 856
 857    def _find_color_light(self, devices: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> str | None:
 858        lights = [
 859            entity for entity in self._iter_entities(devices) if self._entity_supports_color(entity)
 860        ]
 861        if not lights:
 862            return None
 863
 864        request = self._clean_request()
 865        ranked: list[tuple[int, int, str]] = []
 866        for entity in lights:
 867            entity_id = str(entity.get("entity_id") or "")
 868            attrs = self._entity_attrs(entity)
 869            haystack = " ".join(
 870                str(value).lower()
 871                for value in (
 872                    entity_id,
 873                    entity.get("name"),
 874                    entity.get("friendly_name"),
 875                    attrs.get("friendly_name"),
 876                    entity.get("area"),
 877                    entity.get("location"),
 878                )
 879                if value
 880            )
 881            score = 0
 882            for token in request.replace("_", " ").replace("-", " ").split():
 883                token = token.strip(".,!?()[]{}'\"")
 884                if len(token) > 2 and token in haystack:
 885                    score += 1
 886            # Tiebreak: when the user named no specific light, favour the main/
 887            # overhead bulb over an accent strip so "change the light to blue"
 888            # lands on the light they mean. Entity-id sort keeps it deterministic.
 889            ranked.append((score, self._primary_light_preference(haystack), entity_id))
 890        ranked.sort(key=lambda item: (item[0], item[1], item[2]), reverse=True)
 891        return ranked[0][2] if ranked else None
 892
 893    def _primary_light_preference(self, haystack: str) -> int:
 894        """Tiebreak score: +1 per main/overhead hint, -1 per accent/strip hint.
 895
 896        Only breaks ties between equally-matching colour lights; it never
 897        overrides a name the user actually said (that lifts the token score).
 898        """
 899        score = 0
 900        for hint in _PRIMARY_LIGHT_HINTS:
 901            if hint in haystack:
 902                score += 1
 903        for hint in _ACCENT_LIGHT_HINTS:
 904            if hint in haystack:
 905                score -= 1
 906        return score
 907
 908    def _entity_id_supports_color(self, entity_id: str, devices: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> bool:
 909        for entity in self._iter_entities(devices):
 910            if str(entity.get("entity_id") or "") == entity_id:
 911                return self._entity_supports_color(entity)
 912        return False
 913
 914    def _iter_entities(self, node: Any):
 915        if isinstance(node, dict):
 916            entity_id = str(node.get("entity_id") or "")
 917            if entity_id.startswith("light."):
 918                yield node
 919            for value in node.values():
 920                yield from self._iter_entities(value)
 921        elif isinstance(node, list):
 922            for item in node:
 923                yield from self._iter_entities(item)
 924
 925    def _entity_supports_color(self, entity: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
 926        attrs = self._entity_attrs(entity)
 927        modes = attrs.get("supported_color_modes") or []
 928        if isinstance(modes, str):
 929            modes = [modes]
 930        mode_set = {str(mode).lower() for mode in modes}
 931        color_mode = str(attrs.get("color_mode") or "").lower()
 932        return bool(mode_set & _COLOR_MODES) or color_mode in _COLOR_MODES
 933
 934    def _entity_attrs(self, entity: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
 935        attrs: dict[str, Any] = {}
 936        state = entity.get("state")
 937        if isinstance(state, dict) and isinstance(state.get("attributes"), dict):
 938            attrs.update(state["attributes"])
 939        for key in ("attributes", "state_attributes"):
 940            if isinstance(entity.get(key), dict):
 941                attrs.update(entity[key])
 942        return attrs
 943
 944    def _is_allowed(self, action: ActuatorAction) -> bool:
 945        """Whether this caller may execute ``action``. Trusted callers pass None."""
 946        if self.allowed_domains is None:
 947            return True
 948        return str(action.domain or "").lower() in self.allowed_domains
 949
 950    async def _execute_actions(self, actions: list[ActuatorAction]) -> str:
 951        ws_url = normalize_ha_ws_url(CONFIG.ha_url)
 952        successes: list[str] = []
 953        failures: list[str] = []
 954
 955        # Enforced here rather than in the resolver prompt: the prompt is a
 956        # request, this is the gate. Blocked actions never reach call_service.
 957        blocked = [a for a in actions if not self._is_allowed(a)]
 958        actions = [a for a in actions if self._is_allowed(a)]
 959        for action in blocked:
 960            logger.warning(
 961                "[%s] blocked out-of-policy service call %s.%s (allowed domains: %s)",
 962                self.name,
 963                action.domain,
 964                action.service,
 965                ", ".join(sorted(self.allowed_domains or [])),
 966            )
 967        if blocked and not actions:
 968            names = ", ".join(sorted({str(a.domain) for a in blocked}))
 969            return (
 970                f"I can't control {names} from this channel — only everyday devices "
 971                "(lights, switches, climate, media, covers) are available here. "
 972                "Use the dashboard for anything else."
 973            )
 974
 975        async with HAWebSocketClient(ws_url, CONFIG.ha_token) as ha:
 976            for action in actions:
 977                try:
 978                    await ha.call_service(
 979                        action.domain,
 980                        action.service,
 981                        action.entity_id,
 982                        **(action.service_data or {}),
 983                    )
 984                    successes.append(self._format_action(action))
 985                except Exception as exc:
 986                    failures.append(f"{self._format_action(action)} ({exc})")
 987
 988        # Say what was refused, so a partly-blocked request doesn't read as if
 989        # everything the user asked for went through.
 990        note = ""
 991        if blocked:
 992            note = " Skipped (not available on this channel): " + ", ".join(
 993                sorted({f"{a.domain}.{a.service}" for a in blocked})
 994            )
 995
 996        if successes and not failures:
 997            return f"Done: {', '.join(successes)}.{note}"
 998        if failures and not successes:
 999            return "Nothing was executed successfully: " + "; ".join(failures) + note
1000        return (
1001            "Partial success. Completed: "
1002            + ", ".join(successes)
1003            + ". Failed: "
1004            + "; ".join(failures)
1005            + note
1006        )
1007
1008    def _format_action(self, action: ActuatorAction) -> str:
1009        return f"{action.domain}.{action.service} -> {action.entity_id}"
1010
1011    async def _send_result(self, result: str) -> None:
1012        if not self.reply_to_id:
1013            return
1014        await self.send(
1015            self.reply_to_id,
1016            MessageType.RESULT,
1017            {"result": result, "_task_id": self.task_id},
1018        )
1019
1020    def _accumulate_usage(self, usage: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
1021        if not isinstance(usage, dict):
1022            return
1023        self.total_input_tokens += usage.get("input_tokens", 0)
1024        self.total_output_tokens += usage.get("output_tokens", 0)
1025        self.total_cost_usd += usage.get("cost_usd", 0.0)
1026        delta = self.total_cost_usd - self._last_period_cost_usd
1027        if delta > 0:
1028            accumulate_global_cost(delta)
1029            self._last_period_cost_usd = self.total_cost_usd
1030
1031    async def _deferred_stop(self) -> None:
1032        await asyncio.sleep(2.0)
1033        await self._log("Self-terminating.")
1034        if self._registry:
1035            await self._registry.unregister(self.actor_id)
1036        await self.stop()
1037        self._delete_persistence_dir()
1038
1039    async def _log(self, msg: str) -> None:
1040        logger.info("[%s] %s", self.name, msg)
1041        await self._mqtt_publish(
1042            f"agents/{self.actor_id}/logs",
1043            {"type": "log", "message": msg, "timestamp": time.time()},
1044        )
1045
1046    def _delete_persistence_dir(self) -> None:
1047        try:
1048            shutil.rmtree(self._persistence_dir, ignore_errors=False)
1049        except FileNotFoundError:
1050            return
1051        except Exception as exc:
1052            logger.warning(
1053                "[%s] Failed to delete persistence dir %s: %s",
1054                self.name,
1055                self._persistence_dir,
1056                exc,
1057            )
1058
1059    def _build_metrics(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
1060        metrics = super()._build_metrics()
1061        metrics["input_tokens"] = self.total_input_tokens
1062        metrics["output_tokens"] = self.total_output_tokens
1063        metrics["cost_usd"] = round(self.total_cost_usd, 6)
1064        return metrics

Ephemeral actor that resolves and executes one-shot HA service calls.

OneOffActuatorAgent( request: str, llm_provider: wactorz.agents.llm.base.LLMProvider | None, task_id: str, reply_to_id: str, conversation_context: list[dict[str, typing.Any]] | None = None, allowed_domains: frozenset[str] | set[str] | None = None, **kwargs: Any) 
388    def __init__(
389        self,
390        request: str,
391        llm_provider: LLMProvider | None,
392        task_id: str,
393        reply_to_id: str,
394        conversation_context: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
395        allowed_domains: frozenset[str] | set[str] | None = None,
396        **kwargs: Any,
397    ) -> None:
398        kwargs.setdefault("name", f"one-off-actuator-{task_id[-8:]}")
399        super().__init__(**kwargs)
400        self.request = request
401        self.conversation_context = list(conversation_context or [])[-4:]
402        self.llm = llm_provider
403        self.task_id = task_id

405        # None = trusted caller (dashboard/CLI), every domain allowed. A set
406        # restricts execution to those domains; see SOCIAL_ACTUATE_DOMAINS.
407        self.allowed_domains = frozenset(allowed_domains) if allowed_domains is not None else None
408        self.total_input_tokens = 0
409        self.total_output_tokens = 0
410        self.total_cost_usd = 0.0
411        self._last_period_cost_usd = 0.0

async def on_start(self) -> None:

417        await self.publish_manifest(
418            description=self.DESCRIPTION,
419            capabilities=self.CAPABILITIES,

427                "_task_id": "str — correlation id echoed back to the parent actor",

class OpenAIProvider(wactorz.agents.llm.base.LLMProvider): 
 25class OpenAIProvider(LLMProvider):
 26    def __init__(
 27        self, model: str = "gpt-4o", api_key: str | None = None, base_url: str | None = None
 28    ):
 29        import openai
 30
 31        # Two calls rather than a conditional `**{...}`: unpacking a dict of
 32        # unknown keys means a type checker cannot tell which parameter each
 33        # value lands on, so it reports the conflict against every one of them
 34        # — eight errors for a line that was always correct.
 35        self.client = (
 36            openai.AsyncOpenAI(api_key=api_key, base_url=base_url)
 37            if base_url
 38            else openai.AsyncOpenAI(api_key=api_key)
 39        )
 40        self.model = model
 41        self.base_url = base_url or None
 42
 43    @classmethod
 44    def supports_blocks(cls) -> bool:
 45        """Block content is translated to this format's parts on the way out
 46        (see ``openai_shape.openai_content``), so a list content is safe here.
 47        """
 48        return True
 49
 50    async def _complete(self, messages: list[dict], system: str = "", **kwargs) -> tuple[str, dict]:
 51        full_messages = (
 52            [{"role": "system", "content": system}] if system else []
 53        ) + openai_messages(messages)
 54        params = {
 55            "model": self.model,
 56            "messages": full_messages,
 57            "max_completion_tokens": kwargs.get("max_tokens", 16384),
 58            **_temp_params(kwargs),
 59        }
 60        reasoning_effort = kwargs.get("reasoning_effort")
 61        if (
 62            (reasoning_effort == "none" or reasoning_effort is None)
 63            and self.base_url is not None
 64            and "mistral" not in self.model.lower()
 65        ):
 66            params["extra_body"] = {"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": False}}
 67        if reasoning_effort and "mistral" not in self.model.lower():
 68            params["reasoning_effort"] = reasoning_effort
 69        try:
 70            response = await self.client.chat.completions.create(**params)
 71        except Exception as exc:
 72            if reasoning_effort and "reasoning_effort" in str(exc):
 73                params.pop("reasoning_effort", None)
 74                response = await self.client.chat.completions.create(**params)
 75            else:
 76                raise
 77        text = response.choices[0].message.content or ""
 78        usage = {
 79            "input_tokens": response.usage.prompt_tokens,
 80            "output_tokens": response.usage.completion_tokens,
 81            "cost_usd": calc_cost(
 82                self.model, response.usage.prompt_tokens, response.usage.completion_tokens
 83            ),
 84        }
 85        return text, usage
 86
 87    async def _complete_with_tools(
 88        self,
 89        messages: list[dict],
 90        tools: list[dict[str, Any]],
 91        system: str = "",
 92        **kwargs: Any,
 93    ) -> ToolCompletion:
 94        full_messages = (
 95            [{"role": "system", "content": system}] if system else []
 96        ) + openai_messages(
 97            [_openai_tool_result_message(m) if m.get("role") == "tool" else m for m in messages]
 98        )
 99        response = await self.client.chat.completions.create(
100            model=self.model,
101            messages=cast("list[ChatCompletionMessageParam]", full_messages),
102            tools=cast("list[ChatCompletionToolUnionParam]", _openai_tools(tools)),
103            tool_choice=kwargs.get("tool_choice", "auto"),
104            max_completion_tokens=kwargs.get("max_tokens", 16384),
105            **_temp_params(kwargs),
106        )
107        message = response.choices[0].message
108        raw_calls = getattr(message, "tool_calls", None) or []
109        tool_calls = [
110            ToolCall(
111                id=getattr(call, "id", ""),
112                name=getattr(getattr(call, "function", None), "name", ""),
113                arguments=_parse_tool_arguments(
114                    getattr(getattr(call, "function", None), "arguments", "{}")
115                ),
116            )
117            for call in raw_calls
118        ]
119        assistant_message = {
120            "role": "assistant",
121            "content": getattr(message, "content", None),
122        }
123        if raw_calls:
124            assistant_message["tool_calls"] = [
125                {
126                    "id": getattr(call, "id", ""),
127                    "type": "function",
128                    "function": {
129                        "name": getattr(getattr(call, "function", None), "name", ""),
130                        "arguments": getattr(getattr(call, "function", None), "arguments", "{}"),
131                    },
132                }
133                for call in raw_calls
134            ]
135        return ToolCompletion(
136            content=getattr(message, "content", None) or "",
137            usage=_usage_from_openai(self.model, getattr(response, "usage", None)),
138            tool_calls=tool_calls,
139            assistant_message=assistant_message,
140        )
141
142    async def _stream(self, messages: list[dict], system: str = "", **kwargs):
143        """Yield text chunks as they arrive. Final item is a dict with usage."""
144        full_messages = (
145            [{"role": "system", "content": system}] if system else []
146        ) + openai_messages(messages)
147        input_tokens = output_tokens = 0
148        params = {
149            "model": self.model,
150            "messages": full_messages,
151            "max_completion_tokens": kwargs.get("max_tokens", 16384),
152            "stream": True,
153            "stream_options": {"include_usage": True},
154            **_temp_params(kwargs),
155        }
156        reasoning_effort = kwargs.get("reasoning_effort")
157        if reasoning_effort and "mistral" not in self.model.lower():
158            params["reasoning_effort"] = reasoning_effort
159        try:
160            stream = await self.client.chat.completions.create(**params)
161        except Exception as exc:
162            if reasoning_effort and "reasoning_effort" in str(exc):
163                params.pop("reasoning_effort", None)
164                stream = await self.client.chat.completions.create(**params)
165            else:
166                raise
167        async with stream as s:
168            async for chunk in s:
169                delta = chunk.choices[0].delta.content if chunk.choices else None
170                if delta:
171                    yield delta
172                if chunk.usage:
173                    input_tokens = chunk.usage.prompt_tokens
174                    output_tokens = chunk.usage.completion_tokens
175        yield {
176            "input_tokens": input_tokens,
177            "output_tokens": output_tokens,
178            "cost_usd": calc_cost(self.model, input_tokens, output_tokens),
179        }

Base class for LLM providers.

Every route to a paid model goes through one of the three public methods here, and each checks the spend limit before delegating to the provider's own _-prefixed implementation. Subclasses implement those and inherit the check, so a new provider — or a new call site — cannot reach the model without it. The limit previously guarded three call sites in this class while the providers were reachable directly, which most callers did.

28    ):
29        import openai
30
31        # Two calls rather than a conditional `**{...}`: unpacking a dict of
32        # unknown keys means a type checker cannot tell which parameter each
33        # value lands on, so it reports the conflict against every one of them
34        # — eight errors for a line that was always correct.
35        self.client = (
36            openai.AsyncOpenAI(api_key=api_key, base_url=base_url)
37            if base_url
38            else openai.AsyncOpenAI(api_key=api_key)
39        )
40        self.model = model
41        self.base_url = base_url or None
